entries.name: Lorentz.ℍ₂
entries.docstring: A convenient abbreviation for the type of self-adjoint complex 2-by-2 matrices.
entries.snippet: noncomputable abbrev ℍ₂

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.toSelfAdjointMap'
entries.docstring:
Definitionally equal to `Lorentz.SL2C.toSelfAdjointMap` but dropping the requirement that `M` be
special linear.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def toSelfAdjointMap' (M : ℂ²ˣ²) : ℍ₂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℍ₂ where

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.toSelfAdjointMap_det_one'
entries.snippet:
lemma toSelfAdjointMap_det_one' {M : ℂ²ˣ²} (hM : M.IsUpperTriangular) (detM : M.det = 1) :
    LinearMap.det (toSelfAdjointMap' M) = 1

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.toSelfAdjointEquiv
entries.docstring:
This promotes `Lorentz.SL2C.toSelfAdjointMap M` and its definitional equivalence,
`Lorentz.SL2C.toSelfAdjointMap' M`, to a linear equivalence by recognising the linear inverse to be
`Lorentz.SL2C.toSelfAdjointMap M⁻¹`, i.e., `Lorentz.SL2C.toSelfAdjointMap' M⁻¹`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def toSelfAdjointEquiv (M : ℂ²ˣ²) [Invertible M] : ℍ₂ ≃ₗ[ℝ] ℍ₂ where

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.toSelfAdjointMap_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma toSelfAdjointMap_mul (M N : ℂ²ˣ²) :
    toSelfAdjointMap' (M * N) = toSelfAdjointMap' M ∘ₗ toSelfAdjointMap' N

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2C.toSelfAdjointMap_similar_det
entries.snippet:
lemma toSelfAdjointMap_similar_det (M N : ℂ²ˣ²) [Invertible M] :
    LinearMap.det (toSelfAdjointMap' (M * N * M⁻¹)) = LinearMap.det (toSelfAdjointMap' N)

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionCons
entries.docstring:
There is an equivalence between involutions of `Fin n.succ` and involutions of
  `Fin n` and an optional valid choice of an element in `Fin n` (which is where `0`
    in `Fin n.succ` will be sent).
entries.snippet:
def involutionCons (n : ℕ) : {f : Fin n.succ → Fin n.succ // Function.Involutive f } ≃
    (f : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f}) × {i : Option (Fin n) //
      ∀ (h : i.isSome), f.1 (Option.get i h) = (Option.get i h)} where

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionCons_ext
HepLean.Fin.involutionAddEquiv
entries.docstring:
Given an involution of `Fin n`, the optional choice of an element in `Fin n` which
  maps to itself is equivalent to the optional choice of an element in
  `Fin (Finset.univ.filter fun i => f.1 i = i).card`.

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionAddEquiv_none_image_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma involutionAddEquiv_none_image_zero {n : ℕ} :
    {f : {f : Fin n.succ → Fin n.succ // Function.Involutive f}}
    → involutionAddEquiv (involutionCons n f).1 (involutionCons n f).2 = none
    → f.1 ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ n⟩ = ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ n⟩

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionAddEquiv_cast
entries.snippet:
lemma involutionAddEquiv_cast {n : ℕ} {f1 f2 : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f}}
    (hf : f1 = f2) :
    involutionAddEquiv f1 = (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (by rw [hf]; simp)).trans
      ((involutionAddEquiv f2).trans (Equiv.optionCongr (finCongr (by rw [hf]))))

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionAddEquiv_cast'
entries.snippet:
lemma involutionAddEquiv_cast' {m : ℕ} {f1 f2 : {f : Fin m → Fin m // Function.Involutive f}}
    {N : ℕ} (hf : f1 = f2) (n : Option (Fin N))
    (hn1 : N = (Finset.filter (fun i => f1.1 i = i) Finset.univ).card)
    (hn2 : N = (Finset.filter (fun i => f2.1 i = i) Finset.univ).card) :
    HEq ((involutionAddEquiv f1).symm (Option.map (finCongr hn1) n))
    ((involutionAddEquiv f2).symm (Option.map (finCongr hn2) n))

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionAddEquiv_none_succ
HepLean.Fin.involutionAddEquiv_isSome_image_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma involutionAddEquiv_isSome_image_zero {n : ℕ} :
    {f : {f : Fin n.succ → Fin n.succ // Function.Involutive f}}
    → (involutionAddEquiv (involutionCons n f).1 (involutionCons n f).2).isSome
    → ¬ f.1 ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ n⟩ = ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ n⟩

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixedEquivSum
entries.docstring:
Fixed point free involutions of `Fin n.succ` can be separated based on where they sent
  `0`.
entries.snippet:
def involutionNoFixedEquivSum {n : ℕ} :
    {f : Fin n.succ → Fin n.succ // Function.Involutive f
    ∧ ∀ i, f i ≠ i} ≃ Σ (k : Fin n), {f : Fin n.succ → Fin n.succ // Function.Involutive f
    ∧ (∀ i, f i ≠ i) ∧ f 0 = k.succ} where

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixedZeroSetEquivEquiv
entries.docstring:
The condition on fixed point free involutions of `Fin n.succ` for a fixed value of `f 0`,
  can be modified by conjugation with an equivalence.
entries.snippet:
def involutionNoFixedZeroSetEquivEquiv {n : ℕ}
    (k : Fin n) (e : Fin n.succ ≃ Fin n.succ) :
    {f : Fin n.succ → Fin n.succ // Function.Involutive f ∧ (∀ i, f i ≠ i) ∧ f 0 = k.succ} ≃
    {f : Fin n.succ → Fin n.succ // Function.Involutive (e.symm ∘ f ∘ e) ∧
      (∀ i, (e.symm ∘ f ∘ e) i ≠ i) ∧ (e.symm ∘ f ∘ e) 0 = k.succ} where

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixedZeroSetEquivSetEquiv
entries.docstring:
The condition on fixed point free involutions of `Fin n.succ` for a fixed value of `f 0`
  given an equivalence `e`,
  can be modified so that only the condition on `f 0` is up-to the equivalence `e`.

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixedZeroSetEquivEquiv'
entries.docstring:
Fixed point free involutions of `Fin n.succ` fixing `(e.symm ∘ f ∘ e) = k.succ` for a given `e`
  are equivalent to fixing `f (e 0) = e k.succ`.

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixedZeroSetEquivSetOne
entries.docstring:
Fixed point involutions of `Fin n.succ.succ` with `f 0 = k.succ` are equivalent
  to fixed point involutions with `f 0 = 1`.

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixedSetOne
entries.docstring:
Fixed point involutions of `Fin n.succ.succ` fixing `f 0 = 1` are equivalent to
  fixed point involutions of `Fin n`.
entries.snippet:
def involutionNoFixedSetOne {n : ℕ} :
    {f : Fin n.succ.succ → Fin n.succ.succ // Function.Involutive f ∧
    (∀ i, f i ≠ i) ∧ f 0 = 1} ≃ {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f ∧
    (∀ i, f i ≠ i)} where

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixedZeroSetEquiv
entries.docstring:
Fixed point involutions of `Fin n.succ.succ` for fixed `f 0 = k.succ` are
  equivalent to fixed point involutions of `Fin n`.

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixedEquivSumSame
entries.docstring:
The type of fixed point free involutions of `Fin n.succ.succ` is equivalent to the sum
  of `Fin n.succ` copies of fixed point involutions of `Fin n`.

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixedZeroEquivProd
entries.docstring:
Ever fixed-point free involutions of `Fin n.succ.succ` can be decomposed into a
  element of `Fin n.succ` (where `0` is sent) and a fixed-point free involution of
  `Fin n`.

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.«instance@5b9a3bf7»
entries.docstring: The type of fixed-point free involutions of `Fin n` is finite.
entries.snippet: instance {n : ℕ} : Fintype { f // Function.Involutive f ∧ ∀ (i : Fin n), f i ≠ i }

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixed_card_succ
HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixed_card_mul_two
entries.snippet:
lemma involutionNoFixed_card_mul_two : (n : ℕ) →
    Fintype.card {f : Fin (2 * n) → Fin (2 * n) // Function.Involutive f ∧ (∀ i, f i ≠ i)}
    = (2 * n - 1)‼
  | 0 => rfl
  | Nat.succ n => by
    erw [involutionNoFixed_card_succ]
    erw [involutionNoFixed_card_mul_two n]
    exact Eq.symm (Nat.doubleFactorial_add_one (Nat.mul 2 n))

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixed_card_mul_two_plus_one
entries.snippet:
lemma involutionNoFixed_card_mul_two_plus_one : (n : ℕ) →
    Fintype.card {f : Fin (2 * n + 1) → Fin (2 * n + 1) // Function.Involutive f ∧ (∀ i, f i ≠ i)}
    = 0
  | 0 => rfl
  | Nat.succ n => by
    erw [involutionNoFixed_card_succ]
    erw [involutionNoFixed_card_mul_two_plus_one n]
    exact rfl

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixed_card_even
entries.snippet:
lemma involutionNoFixed_card_even : (n : ℕ) → (he : Even n) →
    Fintype.card {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f ∧ (∀ i, f i ≠ i)} = (n - 1)‼

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.involutionNoFixed_card_odd
entries.snippet:
lemma involutionNoFixed_card_odd : (n : ℕ) → (ho : Odd n) →
    Fintype.card {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f ∧ (∀ i, f i ≠ i)} = 0

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSort_length
entries.snippet:
lemma insertionSort_length {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (l : List I) :
    (List.insertionSort le1 l).length = l.length

entries.name: HepLean.List.lt_orderedInsertPos_rel_fin
entries.snippet:
lemma lt_orderedInsertPos_rel_fin {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    (r0 : I) (r : List I) (n : Fin (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).length)
    (hn : n < (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0)) : ¬ le1 r0 ((List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).get n)

entries.name: HepLean.List.orderedInsertEquiv_monotone_fin_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsertEquiv_monotone_fin_succ {I : Type}
    (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I)
    (r0 : I) (n m : Fin r.length)
    (hx : orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0 n.succ < orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0 m.succ) :
    n < m

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSortEquiv_order
entries.snippet:
lemma insertionSortEquiv_order {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop} [DecidableRel r] :
    (l : List α) → (i : Fin l.length) → (j : Fin l.length) → (hij : i < j)
    → (hij' : insertionSortEquiv r l j < insertionSortEquiv r l i) →
    ¬ r l[i] l[j]
  | [], i, _, _, _ => Fin.elim0 i
  | a :: as, ⟨0, hi⟩, ⟨j + 1, hj⟩, hij, hij' => by
    simp only [List.length_cons, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.getElem_fin, Fin.val_zero,
      List.getElem_cons_zero, List.getElem_cons_succ]
    nth_rewrite 2 [insertionSortEquiv] at hij'
    simp only [List.insertionSort.eq_2, List.length_cons, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.zero_eta,
      Equiv.trans_apply, equivCons_zero] at hij'
    have hx

entries.name: HepLean.List.eraseIdx_length'
entries.snippet:
lemma eraseIdx_length' {I : Type} (l : List I) (i : Fin l.length) :
    (List.eraseIdx l i).length = l.length - 1

entries.name: HepLean.List.eraseIdx_length_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma eraseIdx_length_succ {I : Type} (l : List I) (i : Fin l.length) :
    (List.eraseIdx l i).length.succ = l.length

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSortMinPos
entries.docstring:
Given a list `i :: l` the left-most minimial position `a` of `i :: l` wrt `r`.
  That is the first position
  of `l` such that for every element `(i :: l)[b]` before that position
  `r ((i :: l)[b]) ((i :: l)[a])` is not true. The use of `i :: l` here
  rather then just `l` is to ensure that such a position exists. .
entries.snippet:
def insertionSortMinPos {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r] (i : α) (l : List α) :
    Fin (i :: l).length

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSortMin
entries.docstring: The element of `i :: l` at `insertionSortMinPos`.
entries.snippet:
def insertionSortMin {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r] (i : α) (l : List α) :
    α

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSortMin_eq_insertionSort_head
entries.snippet:
lemma insertionSortMin_eq_insertionSort_head {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    (i : α) (l : List α) :
    insertionSortMin r i l = (List.insertionSort r (i :: l)).head (by
    refine List.ne_nil_of_length_pos ?_
    rw [insertionSort_length]
    exact Nat.zero_lt_succ l.length)

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSortDropMinPos
entries.docstring:
The list remaining after dropping the element at the position determined by
  `insertionSortMinPos`.
entries.snippet:
def insertionSortDropMinPos {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r] (i : α) (l : List α) :
    List α

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSort_eq_insertionSortMin_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma insertionSort_eq_insertionSortMin_cons {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [IsTotal α r] [IsTrans α r] (i : α) (l : List α) :
    List.insertionSort r (i :: l) =
    (insertionSortMin r i l) :: List.insertionSort r (insertionSortDropMinPos r i l)

entries.name: HepLean.List.optionEraseZ_some_length
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma optionEraseZ_some_length {I : Type} (l : List I) (a : I) (i : (Fin l.length)) :
    (optionEraseZ l a (some i)).length = l.length - 1

entries.name: HepLean.List.optionEraseZ_ext
entries.snippet:
lemma optionEraseZ_ext {I : Type} {l l' : List I} {a a' : I} {i : Option (Fin l.length)}
    {i' : Option (Fin l'.length)} (hl : l = l') (ha : a = a')
    (hi : Option.map (Fin.cast (by rw [hl])) i = i') :
    optionEraseZ l a i = optionEraseZ l' a' i'

entries.name: HepLean.List.mem_take_finrange
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_take_finrange : (n m : ℕ) → (a : Fin n) → a ∈ List.take m (List.finRange n) ↔ a.val < m
  | 0, m, a => Fin.elim0 a
  | n+1, 0, a => by
    simp
  | n +1, m + 1, ⟨0, h⟩ => by
    simp [List.finRange_succ]
  | n +1, m + 1, ⟨i + 1, h⟩ => by
    simp only [List.finRange_succ, List.take_succ_cons, List.mem_cons, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero,
      AddLeftCancelMonoid.add_eq_zero, one_ne_zero, and_false, false_or, add_lt_add_iff_right]
    rw [← List.map_take]
    rw [@List.mem_map]
    apply Iff.intro
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertIdx_map
entries.snippet:
lemma insertIdx_map {I J : Type} (f : I → J) : (i : ℕ) → (r : List I) → (r0 : I) →
    (List.insertIdx i r0 r).map f = List.insertIdx i (f r0) (r.map f)
  | 0, [], r0 => by simp
  | n+1, [], r0 => by simp
  | 0, a::as, r0 => by simp
  | n+1, a::as, r0 => by
    simp only [List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
    exact insertIdx_map f n as r0

entries.name: HepLean.List.eraseIdx_sorted
entries.snippet:
lemma eraseIdx_sorted {I : Type} (le : I → I → Prop) :
    (r : List I) → (n : ℕ) →
    List.Sorted le r → List.Sorted le (r.eraseIdx n)
  | [], _, _ => by simp
  | a::as, 0, h => by
    simp only [List.eraseIdx]
    simp only [List.sorted_cons] at h
    exact h.2
  | a::as, n+1, h => by
    simp only [List.eraseIdx_cons_succ, List.sorted_cons]
    simp only [List.sorted_cons] at h
    refine And.intro ?_ (eraseIdx_sorted le as n h.2)
    intro b hb
    refine h.1 _ ?_
    exact List.mem_of_mem_eraseIdx hb

entries.name: HepLean.List.mem_eraseIdx_nodup
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_eraseIdx_nodup {I : Type} (i : I) :
    (l : List I) → (n : ℕ) → (hn : n < l.length) → (h : List.Nodup l) →
    i ∈ l.eraseIdx n ↔ i ∈ l ∧ i ≠ l[n]
  | [], _, _, _ => by simp
  | a1 :: as, 0, _, h => by
    simp only [List.eraseIdx_zero, List.tail_cons, List.mem_cons, List.getElem_cons_zero, ne_eq]
    by_cases hi : i = a1
    · subst hi
      simp only [List.nodup_cons] at h
      simp [h]
    · simp [hi]
  | a1 :: as, n+1, hn, h => by
    simp only [List.eraseIdx_cons_succ, List.mem_cons, List.getElem_cons_succ, ne_eq]
    simp only [List.nodup_cons] at h
    rw [mem_eraseIdx_nodup i as n (Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hn) h.2]
    simp_all only [ne_eq]
    obtain ⟨left, right⟩

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertIdx_eq_take_drop
entries.snippet:
lemma insertIdx_eq_take_drop {I : Type} (i : I) : (r : List I) → (n : Fin r.length.succ) →
    List.insertIdx n i r = List.take n r ++ i :: r.drop n
  | [], 0 => by simp
  | a :: as, 0 => by
    simp
  | a :: as, ⟨n + 1, h⟩ => by
    simp only [List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.take_succ_cons, List.drop_succ_cons, List.cons_append,
      List.cons.injEq, true_and]
    exact insertIdx_eq_take_drop i as ⟨n, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h⟩

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertIdx_length_fin
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertIdx_length_fin {I : Type} (i : I) :
    (r : List I) → (n : Fin r.length.succ) →
    (List.insertIdx n i r).length = r.length.succ
  | [], 0 => by simp
  | a :: as, 0 => by simp
  | a :: as, ⟨n + 1, h⟩ => by
    simp only [List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.length_cons, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, add_left_inj]
    exact insertIdx_length_fin i as ⟨n, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h⟩

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertIdx_getElem_fin
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertIdx_getElem_fin {I : Type} (i : I) :
    (r : List I) → (k : Fin r.length.succ) → (m : Fin r.length) →
    (List.insertIdx k i r)[(k.succAbove m).val] = r[m.val]
  | [], 0, m => by exact Fin.elim0 m
  | a :: as, 0, m => by simp
  | a :: as, ⟨n + 1, h⟩, ⟨0, h0⟩ => by
    simp [Fin.succAbove, Fin.lt_def]
  | a :: as, ⟨n + 1, h⟩, ⟨m+1, hm⟩ => by
    simp only [List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.length_cons, Nat.succ_eq_add_one,
      List.getElem_cons_succ]
    conv_rhs => rw [← insertIdx_getElem_fin i as ⟨n, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h⟩
      ⟨m, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hm⟩]
    simp only [Fin.succAbove, Fin.castSucc_mk, Fin.lt_def, add_lt_add_iff_right, Fin.succ_mk,
      Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    split
    · simp_all only [List.getElem_cons_succ]
    · simp_all only [List.getElem_cons_succ]

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertIdx_eraseIdx_fin
entries.snippet:
lemma insertIdx_eraseIdx_fin {I : Type} :
    (r : List I) → (k : Fin r.length) →
    (List.eraseIdx r k).insertIdx k r[k] = r
  | [], k => by exact Fin.elim0 k
  | a :: as, ⟨0, h⟩ => by simp
  | a :: as, ⟨n + 1, h⟩ => by
    simp only [List.length_cons, Fin.getElem_fin, List.getElem_cons_succ, List.eraseIdx_cons_succ,
      List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
    exact insertIdx_eraseIdx_fin as ⟨n, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h⟩

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertIdx_length_fst_append
entries.snippet:
lemma insertIdx_length_fst_append {I : Type} (φ : I) : (φs φs' : List I) →
    List.insertIdx φs.length φ (φs ++ φs') = (φs ++ φ :: φs')
  | [], φs' => by simp
  | φ' :: φs, φs' => by
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.cons_append, List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.cons.injEq,
      true_and]
    exact insertIdx_length_fst_append φ φs φs'

entries.name: HepLean.List.get_eq_insertIdx_succAbove
entries.snippet:
lemma get_eq_insertIdx_succAbove {I : Type} (i : I) (r : List I) (k : Fin r.length.succ) :
    r.get = (List.insertIdx k i r).get ∘
    (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin i r k).symm) ∘ k.succAbove

entries.name: HepLean.List.take_insert_same
entries.snippet:
lemma take_insert_same {I : Type} (i : I) :
    (n : ℕ) → (r : List I) →
    List.take n (List.insertIdx n i r) = List.take n r
  | 0, _ => by simp
  | _+1, [] => by simp
  | n+1, a::as => by
    simp only [List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.take_succ_cons, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
    exact take_insert_same i n as

entries.name: HepLean.List.take_eraseIdx_same
entries.snippet:
lemma take_eraseIdx_same {I : Type} :
    (n : ℕ) → (r : List I) →
    List.take n (List.eraseIdx r n) = List.take n r
  | 0, _ => by simp
  | _+1, [] => by simp
  | n+1, a::as => by
    simp only [List.eraseIdx_cons_succ, List.take_succ_cons, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
    exact take_eraseIdx_same n as

entries.name: HepLean.List.drop_eraseIdx_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma drop_eraseIdx_succ {I : Type} :
    (n : ℕ) → (r : List I) → (hn : n < r.length) →
    r[n] :: List.drop n (List.eraseIdx r n) = List.drop n r
  | 0, _, _=> by
    simp only [List.eraseIdx_zero, List.drop_tail, zero_add, List.drop_one, List.drop_zero]
    rw [@List.getElem_zero]
    exact List.head_cons_tail _ _
  | n+1, [], hn => by simp at hn
  | n+1, a::as, hn => by
    simp only [List.getElem_cons_succ, List.eraseIdx_cons_succ, List.drop_succ_cons]
    refine drop_eraseIdx_succ n as _

entries.name: HepLean.List.take_insert_gt
entries.snippet:
lemma take_insert_gt {I : Type} (i : I) :
    (n m : ℕ) → (h : n < m) → (r : List I) →
    List.take n (List.insertIdx m i r) = List.take n r
  | 0, 0, _, _ => by simp
  | 0, m + 1, _, _ => by simp
  | n+1, m + 1, _, [] => by simp
  | n+1, m + 1, h, a::as => by
    simp only [List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.take_succ_cons, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
    refine take_insert_gt i n m (Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h) as

lemma take_insert_let {I : Type} (i : I) :
    (n m : ℕ) → (h : m ≤ n) → (r : List I) → (hm : m ≤ r.length) →
    (List.take (n + 1) (List.insertIdx m i r)).Perm (i :: List.take n r)
  | 0, 0, h, _, _ => by simp
  | m + 1, 0, h, r, _ => by simp
  | n + 1, m + 1, h, [], hm => by
    simp at hm
  | n + 1, m + 1, h, a::as, hm => by
    simp only [List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.take_succ_cons]
    have hp : (i :: a :: List.take n as).Perm (a :: i :: List.take n as)

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSort_orderedInsert_append
entries.snippet:
lemma insertionSort_orderedInsert_append {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [IsTotal α r] [IsTrans α r] (a : α) : (l1 l2 : List α) →
    List.insertionSort r (List.orderedInsert r a l1 ++ l2) = List.insertionSort r (a :: l1 ++ l2)
  | [], l2 => by
    simp
  | b :: l1, l2 => by
    conv_lhs => simp
    by_cases h : r a b
    · simp [h]
    conv_lhs => simp [h]
    rw [insertionSort_orderedInsert_append r a l1 l2]
    simp only [List.insertionSort, List.append_eq]
    rw [orderedInsert_commute r a b h]

  | a :: l1, l2 => by

    exact insertionSort_insertionSort_append r l2 l3

lemma takeWhile_orderedInsert {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [IsTotal α r] [IsTrans α r]
    (a b : α) (hr : ¬ r a b) : (l : List α) →

lemma insertionSortEquiv_commute {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSortEquiv_orderedInsert_append
entries.snippet:
lemma insertionSortEquiv_orderedInsert_append {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [IsTotal α r] [IsTrans α r] (a a2 : α) : (l1 l2 : List α) →
    (insertionSortEquiv r (List.orderedInsert r a l1 ++ a2 :: l2) ⟨l1.length + 1, by
      simp⟩)
    = (finCongr (by
      simp only [List.insertionSort, List.append_eq, orderedInsert_length, List.length_cons,
        List.length_insertionSort, List.length_append]
      omega))
      ((insertionSortEquiv r (a :: l1 ++ a2 :: l2)) ⟨l1.length + 1, by simp⟩)
  | [], l2 => by
    simp
  | b :: l1, l2 => by
    by_cases h : r a b

lemma insertionSortEquiv_insertionSort_append {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]

    (insertionSortEquiv r (List.insertionSort r l1 ++ a :: l2) ⟨l1.length, by simp⟩)
    = finCongr (by simp) (insertionSortEquiv r (l1 ++ a :: l2) ⟨l1.length, by simp⟩)
  | [], l2 => by

      finCongr_refl, Equiv.refl_apply]
  | b :: l1, l2 => by
    simp only [List.insertionSort, List.length_cons, List.cons_append, finCongr_apply]
    have hl

entries.name: HepLean.List.orderedInsert_filter_of_pos
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsert_filter_of_pos {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [IsTrans α r] (a : α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (h : p a) : (l : List α) →
    (hl : l.Sorted r) →
    List.filter p (List.orderedInsert r a l) = List.orderedInsert r a (List.filter p l)
  | [], hl => by
    simp only [List.orderedInsert, List.filter_eq_self, List.mem_singleton, decide_eq_true_eq,
      forall_eq]
    exact h
  | b :: l, hl => by
    simp only [List.orderedInsert]
    by_cases hpb : p b <;> by_cases hab : r a b
    · simp only [hab, ↓reduceIte, hpb, decide_true, List.filter_cons_of_pos,
      List.orderedInsert.eq_2]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_pos (by simp [h])]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_pos (by simp [hpb])]
    · simp only [hab, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_pos (by simp [hpb])]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_pos (by simp [hpb])]
      simp only [List.orderedInsert, hab, ↓reduceIte, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
      simp only [List.sorted_cons] at hl
      exact orderedInsert_filter_of_pos r a p h l hl.2
    · simp only [hab, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_pos (by simp [h]),
        List.filter_cons_of_neg (by simp [hpb])]
      rw [List.orderedInsert_eq_take_drop]
      have hl : List.takeWhile (fun b => decide ¬r a b)
          (List.filter (fun b => decide (p b)) l) = []

entries.name: HepLean.List.orderedInsert_filter_of_neg
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsert_filter_of_neg {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    (a : α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (h : ¬ p a) (l : List α) :
    List.filter p (List.orderedInsert r a l) = (List.filter p l)

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSort_filter
entries.snippet:
lemma insertionSort_filter {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r] [IsTotal α r]
    [IsTrans α r] (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] : (l : List α) →
    List.insertionSort r (List.filter p l) =
    List.filter p (List.insertionSort r l)
  | [] => by simp
  | a :: l => by
    simp only [List.insertionSort]
    by_cases h : p a
    · rw [orderedInsert_filter_of_pos]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_pos]
      simp only [List.insertionSort]
      rw [insertionSort_filter]
      simp_all only [decide_true]
      simp_all only
      exact List.sorted_insertionSort r l
    · rw [orderedInsert_filter_of_neg]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_neg]
      rw [insertionSort_filter]
      simp_all only [decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, not_false_eq_true]
      exact h

entries.name: HepLean.List.takeWhile_sorted_eq_filter
entries.snippet:
lemma takeWhile_sorted_eq_filter {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [IsTrans α r] (a : α) : (l : List α) → (hl : l.Sorted r) →
    List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ r a c) l = List.filter (fun c => ¬ r a c) l
  | [], _ => by simp
  | b :: l, hl => by
    simp only [List.sorted_cons] at hl
    by_cases hb : ¬ r a b
    · simp only [decide_not, hb, decide_false, Bool.not_false, List.takeWhile_cons_of_pos,
      List.filter_cons_of_pos, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
      simpa using takeWhile_sorted_eq_filter r a l hl.2
    · simp_all only [Decidable.not_not, decide_not, decide_true, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true,
      not_false_eq_true, List.takeWhile_cons_of_neg, List.filter_cons_of_neg, List.nil_eq,
      List.filter_eq_nil_iff, Bool.not_eq_eq_eq_not, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
      intro c hc
      apply IsTrans.trans a b c hb
      exact hl.1 c hc

entries.name: HepLean.List.dropWhile_sorted_eq_filter
entries.snippet:
lemma dropWhile_sorted_eq_filter {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [IsTrans α r] (a : α) : (l : List α) → (hl : l.Sorted r) →
    List.dropWhile (fun c => ¬ r a c) l = List.filter (fun c => r a c) l
  | [], _ => by simp
  | b :: l, hl => by
    simp only [List.sorted_cons] at hl
    by_cases hb : ¬ r a b
    · simp only [decide_not, hb, decide_false, Bool.not_false, List.dropWhile_cons_of_pos,
      Bool.false_eq_true, not_false_eq_true, List.filter_cons_of_neg]
      simpa using dropWhile_sorted_eq_filter r a l hl.2
    · simp_all only [Decidable.not_not, decide_not, decide_true, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true,
      not_false_eq_true, List.dropWhile_cons_of_neg, List.filter_cons_of_pos, List.cons.injEq,
      true_and]
      symm
      rw [List.filter_eq_self]
      intro c hc
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
      apply IsTrans.trans a b c hb
      exact hl.1 c hc

entries.name: HepLean.List.dropWhile_sorted_eq_filter_filter
entries.snippet:
lemma dropWhile_sorted_eq_filter_filter {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [IsTrans α r] (a : α) :(l : List α) → (hl : l.Sorted r) →
    List.filter (fun c => r a c) l =
    List.filter (fun c => r a c ∧ r c a) l ++ List.filter (fun c => r a c ∧ ¬ r c a) l
  | [], _ => by
    simp
  | b :: l, hl => by
    simp only [List.sorted_cons] at hl
    by_cases hb : ¬ r a b
    · simp only [hb, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, not_false_eq_true, List.filter_cons_of_neg,
      Bool.decide_and, Bool.false_and, decide_not]
      simpa using dropWhile_sorted_eq_filter_filter r a l hl.2
    · simp_all only [Decidable.not_not, decide_true, List.filter_cons_of_pos, Bool.decide_and,
      decide_not]
      by_cases hba : r b a
      · simp only [hba, decide_true, Bool.not_true, Bool.and_false, Bool.false_eq_true,
        not_false_eq_true, List.filter_cons_of_neg]
        rw [List.filter_cons_of_pos]
        rw [dropWhile_sorted_eq_filter_filter]
        simp only [Bool.decide_and, decide_not, List.cons_append]
        exact hl.2
        simp_all
      · simp only [hba, decide_false, Bool.and_false, Bool.false_eq_true, not_false_eq_true,
        List.filter_cons_of_neg]
        have h1 : List.filter (fun c => decide (r a c) && decide (r c a)) l = []

entries.name: HepLean.List.filter_rel_eq_insertionSort

lemma filter_rel_eq_insertionSort {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSort_of_eq_list
entries.snippet:
lemma insertionSort_of_eq_list {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [IsTotal α r] [IsTrans α r] (a : α) (l1 l l2 : List α)
    (h : ∀ b ∈ l, r a b ∧ r b a) :
    List.insertionSort r (l1 ++ l ++ l2) =
    (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ r a c) ((l1 ++ l2).insertionSort r))
    ++ (List.filter (fun c => r a c ∧ r c a) l1)
    ++ l
    ++ (List.filter (fun c => r a c ∧ r c a) l2)
    ++ (List.filter (fun c => r a c ∧ ¬ r c a) ((l1 ++ l2).insertionSort r))

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter

lemma insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]

decidable.

instance [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] : DecidableEq (Σ b, cond b m n)
  | ⟨true, _⟩, ⟨false, _⟩
  | ⟨false, _⟩, ⟨true, _⟩ => isFalse nofun
  | ⟨false, i⟩, ⟨false, j⟩

The change of basis that induces the upper triangular form `A.schurTriangulation` of a matrix
`A` over an algebraically closed field.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def schurTriangulationBasis : OrthonormalBasis n 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)

entries.name: Matrix.schurTriangulationUnitary
entries.docstring:
The unitary matrix that induces the upper triangular form `A.schurTriangulation` to which a
matrix `A` over an algebraically closed field is unitarily similar.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def schurTriangulationUnitary : unitaryGroup n 𝕜 where

entries.name: Matrix.schurTriangulation
entries.docstring:
The upper triangular form induced by `A.schurTriangulationUnitary` to which a matrix `A` over an
algebraically closed field is unitarily similar.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def schurTriangulation : UpperTriangular n 𝕜

entries.name: Matrix.schur_triangulation
entries.docstring:
**Schur triangulation**, **Schur decomposition** for matrices over an algebraically closed
field. In particular, a complex matrix can be converted to upper-triangular form by a change of
basis. In other words, any complex matrix is unitarily similar to an upper triangular matrix.
entries.snippet:
lemma schur_triangulation :
    A = A.schurTriangulationUnitary * A.schurTriangulation * star A.schurTriangulationUnitary

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra
entries.docstring:
The creation and annihlation free-algebra.
  The free algebra generated by `CrAnStates`,
  that is a position based states or assymptotic states with a specification of
  whether the state is a creation or annihlation state.
  As a module `CrAnAlgebra` is spanned by lists of `CrAnStates`.
entries.snippet: abbrev CrAnAlgebra (𝓕 : FieldSpecification) : Type

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofCrAnState
entries.docstring: Maps a creation and annihlation state to the creation and annihlation free-algebra.
entries.snippet: def ofCrAnState (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates) : CrAnAlgebra 𝓕

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofCrAnList
entries.docstring:
Maps a list creation and annihlation state to the creation and annihlation free-algebra
  by taking their product.
entries.snippet: def ofCrAnList (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) : CrAnAlgebra 𝓕

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofCrAnList_nil
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofCrAnList_nil : ofCrAnList ([] : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) = 1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofCrAnList_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma ofCrAnList_cons (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates) (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    ofCrAnList (φ :: φs) = ofCrAnState φ * ofCrAnList φs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofCrAnList_append
entries.snippet:
lemma ofCrAnList_append (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    ofCrAnList (φs ++ φs') = ofCrAnList φs * ofCrAnList φs'

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofCrAnList_singleton
entries.snippet:
lemma ofCrAnList_singleton (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    ofCrAnList [φ] = ofCrAnState φ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofState
entries.docstring:
Maps a state to the sum of creation and annihilation operators in
  creation and annihilation free-algebra.
entries.snippet: def ofState (φ : 𝓕.States) : CrAnAlgebra 𝓕

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofStateList
entries.docstring:
Maps a list of states to the creation and annihilation free-algebra by taking
  the product of their sums of creation and annihlation operators.
  Roughly `[φ1, φ2]` gets sent to `(φ1ᶜ+ φ1ᵃ) * (φ2ᶜ+ φ2ᵃ)` etc.
entries.snippet: def ofStateList (φs : List 𝓕.States) : CrAnAlgebra 𝓕

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.«instance@1ff487a2»
entries.docstring: Coercion from `List 𝓕.States` to `CrAnAlgebra 𝓕` through `ofStateList`.
entries.snippet: instance : Coe (List 𝓕.States) (CrAnAlgebra 𝓕)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofStateList_nil
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofStateList_nil : ofStateList ([] : List 𝓕.States) = 1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofStateList_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma ofStateList_cons (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) :
    ofStateList (φ :: φs) = ofState φ * ofStateList φs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofStateList_singleton
entries.snippet:
lemma ofStateList_singleton (φ : 𝓕.States) :
    ofStateList [φ] = ofState φ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofStateList_append
entries.snippet:
lemma ofStateList_append (φs φs' : List 𝓕.States) :
    ofStateList (φs ++ φs') = ofStateList φs * ofStateList φs'

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofStateList_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma ofStateList_sum (φs : List 𝓕.States) :
    ofStateList φs = ∑ (s : CrAnSection φs), ofCrAnList s.1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.crPartF
entries.docstring:
The algebra map taking an element of the free-state algbra to
  the part of it in the creation and annihlation free algebra
  spanned by creation operators.
entries.snippet: def crPartF : 𝓕.States → 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.crPartF_negAsymp
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma crPartF_negAsymp (φ : 𝓕.IncomingAsymptotic) :
    crPartF (States.inAsymp φ) = ofCrAnState ⟨States.inAsymp φ, ()⟩

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.crPartF_position
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma crPartF_position (φ : 𝓕.PositionStates) :
    crPartF (States.position φ) =
    ofCrAnState ⟨States.position φ, CreateAnnihilate.create⟩

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.crPartF_posAsymp
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma crPartF_posAsymp (φ : 𝓕.OutgoingAsymptotic) :
    crPartF (States.outAsymp φ) = 0

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.anPartF
entries.docstring:
The algebra map taking an element of the free-state algbra to
  the part of it in the creation and annihilation free algebra
  spanned by annihilation operators.
entries.snippet: def anPartF : 𝓕.States → 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.anPartF_negAsymp
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma anPartF_negAsymp (φ : 𝓕.IncomingAsymptotic) :
    anPartF (States.inAsymp φ) = 0

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.anPartF_position
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma anPartF_position (φ : 𝓕.PositionStates) :
    anPartF (States.position φ) =
    ofCrAnState ⟨States.position φ, CreateAnnihilate.annihilate⟩

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.anPartF_posAsymp
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma anPartF_posAsymp (φ : 𝓕.OutgoingAsymptotic) :
    anPartF (States.outAsymp φ) = ofCrAnState ⟨States.outAsymp φ, ()⟩

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofState_eq_crPartF_add_anPartF
entries.snippet:
lemma ofState_eq_crPartF_add_anPartF (φ : 𝓕.States) :
    ofState φ = crPartF φ + anPartF φ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofCrAnListBasis
entries.docstring: The basis of the free creation and annihilation algebra formed by lists of CrAnStates.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ofCrAnListBasis : Basis (List 𝓕.CrAnStates) ℂ (CrAnAlgebra 𝓕) where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofListBasis_eq_ofList
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofListBasis_eq_ofList (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    ofCrAnListBasis φs = ofCrAnList φs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.mulLinearMap
entries.docstring: The bi-linear map associated with multiplication in `CrAnAlgebra`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def mulLinearMap : CrAnAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] CrAnAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] CrAnAlgebra 𝓕 where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.mulLinearMap_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma mulLinearMap_apply (a b : CrAnAlgebra 𝓕) :
    mulLinearMap a b = a * b

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.smulLinearMap
entries.docstring: The linear map associated with scalar-multiplication in `CrAnAlgebra`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def smulLinearMap (c : ℂ) : CrAnAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] CrAnAlgebra 𝓕 where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.statisticSubmodule
entries.docstring: The submodule of `CrAnAlgebra` spanned by lists of field statistic `f`.
entries.snippet: def statisticSubmodule (f : FieldStatistic) : Submodule ℂ 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofCrAnList_mem_statisticSubmodule_of
entries.snippet:
lemma ofCrAnList_mem_statisticSubmodule_of (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) (f : FieldStatistic)
    (h : (𝓕 |>ₛ φs) = f) :
    ofCrAnList φs ∈ statisticSubmodule f

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofCrAnList_bosonic_or_fermionic
entries.snippet:
lemma ofCrAnList_bosonic_or_fermionic (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    ofCrAnList φs ∈ statisticSubmodule bosonic ∨ ofCrAnList φs ∈ statisticSubmodule fermionic

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofCrAnState_bosonic_or_fermionic
entries.snippet:
lemma ofCrAnState_bosonic_or_fermionic (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    ofCrAnState φ ∈ statisticSubmodule bosonic ∨ ofCrAnState φ ∈ statisticSubmodule fermionic

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.bosonicProj
entries.docstring: The projection of an element of `CrAnAlgebra` onto it's bosonic part.
entries.snippet: def bosonicProj : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] statisticSubmodule (𝓕 := 𝓕) bosonic

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.bosonicProj_ofCrAnList
entries.snippet:
lemma bosonicProj_ofCrAnList (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    bosonicProj (ofCrAnList φs) = if h : (𝓕 |>ₛ φs) = bosonic then
      ⟨ofCrAnList φs, Submodule.mem_span.mpr fun _ a => a ⟨φs, ⟨rfl, h⟩⟩⟩ else 0

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.bosonicProj_of_mem_bosonic
entries.snippet:
lemma bosonicProj_of_mem_bosonic (a : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra) (h : a ∈ statisticSubmodule bosonic) :
    bosonicProj a = ⟨a, h⟩

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.bosonicProj_of_mem_fermionic
entries.snippet:
lemma bosonicProj_of_mem_fermionic (a : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra) (h : a ∈ statisticSubmodule fermionic) :
    bosonicProj a = 0

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.bosonicProj_of_bonosic_part
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma bosonicProj_of_bonosic_part
    (a : DirectSum FieldStatistic (fun i => (statisticSubmodule (𝓕 := 𝓕) i))) :
    bosonicProj (a bosonic) = a bosonic

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.bosonicProj_of_fermionic_part
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma bosonicProj_of_fermionic_part
    (a : DirectSum FieldStatistic (fun i => (statisticSubmodule (𝓕 := 𝓕) i))) :
    bosonicProj (a fermionic).1 = 0

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.fermionicProj
entries.docstring: The projection of an element of `CrAnAlgebra` onto it's fermionic part.
entries.snippet: def fermionicProj : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] statisticSubmodule (𝓕 := 𝓕) fermionic

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.fermionicProj_ofCrAnList
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionicProj_ofCrAnList (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    fermionicProj (ofCrAnList φs) = if h : (𝓕 |>ₛ φs) = fermionic then
      ⟨ofCrAnList φs, Submodule.mem_span.mpr fun _ a => a ⟨φs, ⟨rfl, h⟩⟩⟩ else 0

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.fermionicProj_ofCrAnList_if_bosonic
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionicProj_ofCrAnList_if_bosonic (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    fermionicProj (ofCrAnList φs) = if h : (𝓕 |>ₛ φs) = bosonic then
      0 else ⟨ofCrAnList φs, Submodule.mem_span.mpr fun _ a => a ⟨φs, ⟨rfl,
        by simpa using h⟩⟩⟩

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.fermionicProj_of_mem_fermionic
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionicProj_of_mem_fermionic (a : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra) (h : a ∈ statisticSubmodule fermionic) :
    fermionicProj a = ⟨a, h⟩

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.fermionicProj_of_mem_bosonic
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionicProj_of_mem_bosonic (a : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra) (h : a ∈ statisticSubmodule bosonic) :
    fermionicProj a = 0

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.fermionicProj_of_bosonic_part
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fermionicProj_of_bosonic_part
    (a : DirectSum FieldStatistic (fun i => (statisticSubmodule (𝓕 := 𝓕) i))) :
    fermionicProj (a bosonic).1 = 0

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.fermionicProj_of_fermionic_part
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fermionicProj_of_fermionic_part
    (a : DirectSum FieldStatistic (fun i => (statisticSubmodule (𝓕 := 𝓕) i))) :
    fermionicProj (a fermionic) = a fermionic

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.bosonicProj_add_fermionicProj
entries.snippet:
lemma bosonicProj_add_fermionicProj (a : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra) :
    a.bosonicProj + (a.fermionicProj).1 = a

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.coeAddMonoidHom_apply_eq_bosonic_plus_fermionic
entries.snippet:
lemma coeAddMonoidHom_apply_eq_bosonic_plus_fermionic
    (a : DirectSum FieldStatistic (fun i => (statisticSubmodule (𝓕 := 𝓕) i))) :
    DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom statisticSubmodule a = a.1 bosonic + a.1 fermionic

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.directSum_eq_bosonic_plus_fermionic
entries.snippet:
lemma directSum_eq_bosonic_plus_fermionic
    (a : DirectSum FieldStatistic (fun i => (statisticSubmodule (𝓕 := 𝓕) i))) :
    a = (DirectSum.of (fun i => ↥(statisticSubmodule i)) bosonic) (a bosonic) +
    (DirectSum.of (fun i => ↥(statisticSubmodule i)) fermionic) (a fermionic)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.crAnAlgebraGrade
entries.docstring: The instance of a graded algebra on `CrAnAlgebra`.
entries.snippet: instance crAnAlgebraGrade : GradedAlgebra (A := 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra) statisticSubmodule where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.eq_zero_of_bosonic_and_fermionic
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_of_bosonic_and_fermionic {a : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra}
    (hb : a ∈ statisticSubmodule bosonic) (hf : a ∈ statisticSubmodule fermionic) : a = 0

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.bosonicProj_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma bosonicProj_mul (a b : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra) :
    (a * b).bosonicProj.1 = a.bosonicProj.1 * b.bosonicProj.1
    + a.fermionicProj.1 * b.fermionicProj.1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.fermionicProj_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma fermionicProj_mul (a b : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra) :
    (a * b).fermionicProj.1 = a.bosonicProj.1 * b.fermionicProj.1
    + a.fermionicProj.1 * b.bosonicProj.1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF
entries.docstring:
The linear map on the free creation and annihlation
  algebra defined as the map taking
  a list of CrAnStates to the normal-ordered list of states multiplied by
  the sign corresponding to the number of fermionic-fermionic
  exchanges done in ordering.
entries.snippet: def normalOrderF : CrAnAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] CrAnAlgebra 𝓕

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF_ofCrAnList
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderF_ofCrAnList (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    𝓝ᶠ(ofCrAnList φs) = normalOrderSign φs • ofCrAnList (normalOrderList φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.ofCrAnList_eq_normalOrderF
entries.snippet:
lemma ofCrAnList_eq_normalOrderF (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    ofCrAnList (normalOrderList φs) = normalOrderSign φs • 𝓝ᶠ(ofCrAnList φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF_one
entries.snippet: lemma normalOrderF_one : normalOrderF (𝓕 := 𝓕) 1 = 1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF_ofCrAnList_cons_create
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderF_ofCrAnList_cons_create (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.create) (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    𝓝ᶠ(ofCrAnList (φ :: φs)) = ofCrAnState φ * 𝓝ᶠ(ofCrAnList φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF_create_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderF_create_mul (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.create) (a : CrAnAlgebra 𝓕) :
    𝓝ᶠ(ofCrAnState φ * a) = ofCrAnState φ * 𝓝ᶠ(a)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF_ofCrAnList_append_annihilate
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderF_ofCrAnList_append_annihilate (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    𝓝ᶠ(ofCrAnList (φs ++ [φ])) = 𝓝ᶠ(ofCrAnList φs) * ofCrAnState φ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF_mul_annihilate
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderF_mul_annihilate (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (a : CrAnAlgebra 𝓕) : 𝓝ᶠ(a * ofCrAnState φ) = 𝓝ᶠ(a) * ofCrAnState φ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF_crPartF_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderF_crPartF_mul (φ : 𝓕.States) (a : CrAnAlgebra 𝓕) :
    𝓝ᶠ(crPartF φ * a) =
    crPartF φ * 𝓝ᶠ(a)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF_mul_anPartF
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderF_mul_anPartF (φ : 𝓕.States) (a : CrAnAlgebra 𝓕) :
    𝓝ᶠ(a * anPartF φ) =
    𝓝ᶠ(a) * anPartF φ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF_swap_create_annihlate_ofCrAnList_ofCrAnList
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderF_swap_create_annihlate_ofCrAnList_ofCrAnList (φc φa : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create) (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    𝓝ᶠ(ofCrAnList φs' * ofCrAnState φc * ofCrAnState φa * ofCrAnList φs) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φc, 𝓕 |>ₛ φa) •
    𝓝ᶠ(ofCrAnList φs' * ofCrAnState φa * ofCrAnState φc * ofCrAnList φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF_swap_create_annihlate_ofCrAnList
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderF_swap_create_annihlate_ofCrAnList (φc φa : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create) (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) (a : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra) :
    𝓝ᶠ(ofCrAnList φs * ofCrAnState φc * ofCrAnState φa * a) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φc, 𝓕 |>ₛ φa) •
    𝓝ᶠ(ofCrAnList φs * ofCrAnState φa * ofCrAnState φc * a)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF_swap_create_annihlate
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderF_swap_create_annihlate (φc φa : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create) (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (a b : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra) :
    𝓝ᶠ(a * ofCrAnState φc * ofCrAnState φa * b) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φc, 𝓕 |>ₛ φa) •
    𝓝ᶠ(a * ofCrAnState φa * ofCrAnState φc * b)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF_superCommuteF_create_annihilate
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderF_superCommuteF_create_annihilate (φc φa : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create) (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (a b : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra) :
    𝓝ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnState φc, ofCrAnState φa]ₛca * b) = 0

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.normalOrderF_superCommuteF_annihilate_create

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.superCommuteF
entries.docstring:
The super commutor on the creation and annihlation algebra. For two bosonic operators
  or a bosonic and fermionic operator this corresponds to the usual commutator
  whilst for two fermionic operators this corresponds to the anti-commutator.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def superCommuteF : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.superCommuteF_ofCrAnList_ofCrAnList_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
Within the creation and annihilation algebra, we have that
`[φᶜᵃs, φᶜᵃ₀ … φᶜᵃₙ]ₛca = ∑ i, sᵢ • φᶜᵃs₀ … φᶜᵃᵢ₋₁ * [φᶜᵃs, φᶜᵃᵢ]ₛca * φᶜᵃᵢ₊₁ … φᶜᵃₙ`
where `sᵢ` is the exchange sign for `φᶜᵃs` and `φᶜᵃs₀ … φᶜᵃᵢ₋₁`.
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommuteF_ofCrAnList_ofCrAnList_eq_sum (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    (φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) → [ofCrAnList φs, ofCrAnList φs']ₛca =
    ∑ (n : Fin φs'.length), 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs'.take n) •
    ofCrAnList (φs'.take n) * [ofCrAnList φs, ofCrAnState (φs'.get n)]ₛca *
    ofCrAnList (φs'.drop (n + 1))
  | [] => by
    simp [← ofCrAnList_nil, superCommuteF_ofCrAnList_ofCrAnList]
  | φ :: φs' => by
    rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnList_ofCrAnList_cons, superCommuteF_ofCrAnList_ofCrAnList_eq_sum φs φs']
    conv_rhs => erw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    congr 1
    · simp
    · simp [Finset.mul_sum, smul_smul, ofCrAnList_cons, mul_assoc,
        FieldStatistic.ofList_cons_eq_mul, mul_comm]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.superCommuteF_ofCrAnList_ofStateList_eq_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommuteF_ofCrAnList_ofStateList_eq_sum (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) : (φs' : List 𝓕.States) →
    [ofCrAnList φs, ofStateList φs']ₛca =
    ∑ (n : Fin φs'.length), 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs'.take n) •
      ofStateList (φs'.take n) * [ofCrAnList φs, ofState (φs'.get n)]ₛca *
      ofStateList (φs'.drop (n + 1))
  | [] => by
    simp only [superCommuteF_ofCrAnList_ofStatesList, instCommGroup, ofList_empty,
      exchangeSign_bosonic, one_smul, List.length_nil, Finset.univ_eq_empty, List.take_nil,
      List.get_eq_getElem, List.drop_nil, Finset.sum_empty]
    simp
  | φ :: φs' => by
    rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnList_ofStateList_cons,
      superCommuteF_ofCrAnList_ofStateList_eq_sum φs φs']
    conv_rhs => erw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    congr 1
    · simp
    · simp [Finset.mul_sum, smul_smul, ofStateList_cons, mul_assoc,
        FieldStatistic.ofList_cons_eq_mul, mul_comm]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.timeOrderF_eq_maxTimeField_mul
entries.docstring:
In the state algebra time, ordering obeys `T(φ₀φ₁…φₙ) = s * φᵢ * T(φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁…φₙ)`
  where `φᵢ` is the state
  which has maximum time and `s` is the exchange sign of `φᵢ` and `φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁`.
entries.snippet:
lemma timeOrderF_eq_maxTimeField_mul (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) :
    𝓣ᶠ(ofStateList (φ :: φs)) =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ maxTimeField φ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ (φ :: φs).take (maxTimeFieldPos φ φs)) •
    ofState (maxTimeField φ φs) * 𝓣ᶠ(ofStateList (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnAlgebra.timeOrderF_eq_maxTimeField_mul_finset
entries.docstring:
In the state algebra time, ordering obeys `T(φ₀φ₁…φₙ) = s * φᵢ * T(φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁…φₙ)`
  where `φᵢ` is the state
  which has maximum time and `s` is the exchange sign of `φᵢ` and `φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁`.
  Here `s` is written using finite sets.
entries.snippet:
lemma timeOrderF_eq_maxTimeField_mul_finset (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) :
    𝓣ᶠ(ofStateList (φ :: φs)) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ maxTimeField φ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨(eraseMaxTimeField φ φs).get,
      (Finset.filter (fun x =>
        (maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs).succAbove x < maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs) Finset.univ)⟩) •
      ofState (maxTimeField φ φs) * 𝓣ᶠ(ofStateList (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra.anPart_superCommute_normalOrder_ofFieldOpList_sum
entries.docstring:
Within a proto-operator algebra we have that
`[anPartF φ, 𝓝(φs)] = ∑ i, sᵢ • [anPartF φ, φᵢ]ₛ * 𝓝(φ₀…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁…φₙ)`
where `sᵢ` is the exchange sign for `φ` and `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁`.
entries.snippet:
lemma anPart_superCommute_normalOrder_ofFieldOpList_sum (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) :
    [anPart φ, 𝓝(ofFieldOpList φs)]ₛ = ∑ n : Fin φs.length, 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ (φs.take n)) •
    [anPart φ, ofState φs[n]]ₛ * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList (φs.eraseIdx n))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra.anPart_mul_normalOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_superCommute_reorder
entries.docstring:
Within a proto-operator algebra we have that
`anPartF φ * 𝓝(φ₀φ₁…φₙ) = 𝓝((anPart φ)φ₀φ₁…φₙ) + [anpart φ, 𝓝(φ₀φ₁…φₙ)]ₛ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma anPart_mul_normalOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_superCommute_reorder (φ : 𝓕.States)
    (φs : List 𝓕.States) : anPart φ * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList φs) =
    𝓝(anPart φ * ofFieldOpList φs) + [anPart φ, 𝓝(ofFieldOpList φs)]ₛ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra.ofFieldOp_mul_normalOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_superCommute
entries.docstring:
Within a proto-operator algebra we have that
`φ * 𝓝ᶠ(φ₀φ₁…φₙ) = 𝓝ᶠ(φφ₀φ₁…φₙ) + [anpart φ, 𝓝ᶠ(φ₀φ₁…φₙ)]ₛca`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofFieldOp_mul_normalOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_superCommute (φ : 𝓕.States)
    (φs : List 𝓕.States) : ofFieldOp φ * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList φs) =
    𝓝(ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOpList φs) + [anPart φ, 𝓝(ofFieldOpList φs)]ₛ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra.contractStateAtIndex
entries.docstring:
In the expansion of `ofState φ * normalOrderF (ofStateList φs)` the element
  of `𝓞.A` associated with contracting `φ` with the (optional) `n`th element of `φs`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def contractStateAtIndex (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (n : Option (Fin φs.length)) : 𝓕.FieldOpAlgebra

entries.name: FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra.ofFieldOp_mul_normalOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
Within a proto-operator algebra,
`φ * N(φ₀φ₁…φₙ) = N(φφ₀φ₁…φₙ) + ∑ i, (sᵢ • [anPartF φ, φᵢ]ₛ) * N(φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁…φₙ)`,
where `sₙ` is the exchange sign for `φ` and `φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofFieldOp_mul_normalOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_sum (φ : 𝓕.States)
    (φs : List 𝓕.States) : ofFieldOp φ * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList φs) =
    ∑ n : Option (Fin φs.length), contractStateAtIndex φ φs n *
    𝓝(ofFieldOpList (HepLean.List.optionEraseZ φs φ n))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra.ofFieldOpList_normalOrder_insert
entries.docstring:
Within a proto-operator algebra, `N(φφ₀φ₁…φₙ) = s • N(φ₀…φₖ₋₁φφₖ…φₙ)`, where
`s` is the exchange sign for `φ` and `φ₀…φₖ₋₁`.
entries.snippet:
lemma ofFieldOpList_normalOrder_insert (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (k : Fin φs.length.succ) : 𝓝(ofFieldOpList (φ :: φs)) =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs.take k) • 𝓝(ofFieldOpList (φs.insertIdx k φ))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra.static_wick_theorem_nil
entries.snippet:
lemma static_wick_theorem_nil : ofFieldOpList [] = ∑ (φsΛ : WickContraction [].length),
    φsΛ.sign (𝓕 := 𝓕) • φsΛ.staticContract * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra.static_wick_theorem
entries.snippet:
theorem static_wick_theorem : (φs : List 𝓕.States) →
    ofFieldOpList φs = ∑ (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length),
    φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.staticContract * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)
  | [] => static_wick_theorem_nil
  | φ :: φs => by
    rw [ofFieldOpList_cons]
    rw [static_wick_theorem φs]
    rw [show  (φ :: φs) = φs.insertIdx (⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ φs.length⟩ : Fin φs.length.succ) φ
      from rfl]
    conv_rhs => rw [insertLift_sum ]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro c _
    trans  (sign φs c • ↑c.staticContract * (ofFieldOp φ * normalOrder (ofFieldOpList [c]ᵘᶜ)))
    · have ht

  as their time ordering in the state algebra minus their normal ordering in the

      crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ3 ∧
      crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ2) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnList φs1 * [ofCrAnState φ1, [ofCrAnState φ2, ofCrAnState φ3]ₛca]ₛca *
    ofCrAnList φs2) = 0

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnList {φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnStates}
    (φs1 φs2 : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnList φs1 * [ofCrAnState φ1, [ofCrAnState φ2, ofCrAnState φ3]ₛca]ₛca * ofCrAnList φs2)
    = 0

entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF {φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnStates} (a b : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnState φ1, [ofCrAnState φ2, ofCrAnState φ3]ₛca]ₛca * b) = 0

entries.name: FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
entries.snippet:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnStates}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.CrAnAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnState φ, ofCrAnState ψ]ₛca * b) =

entries.name: FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra.timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF

entries.name: FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra.timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_ordered
entries.snippet:
lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.States} (h : timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    𝓣(ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ) = ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ

lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_not_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.States} (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :

@[simp]
lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_singleton (φ : 𝓕.States) :

entries.name: FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra.timeOrder_eq_maxTimeField_mul_finset
entries.snippet:
lemma timeOrder_eq_maxTimeField_mul_finset (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) :
