      (Finset.filter (fun x =>
        (maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs).succAbove x < maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs) Finset.univ)⟩) •
      ofFieldOp (maxTimeField φ φs) * 𝓣(ofFieldOpList (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs))

entries.name: CreateAnnihilate
entries.docstring: The type specifing whether an operator is a creation or annihilation operator.
entries.snippet:
inductive CreateAnnihilate where
  | create : CreateAnnihilate
  | annihilate : CreateAnnihilate

entries.name: CreateAnnihilate.«instance@75c758c5»
entries.docstring: The type `CreateAnnihilate` is finite.
entries.snippet: instance : Fintype CreateAnnihilate where

entries.name: CreateAnnihilate.eq_create_or_annihilate
entries.snippet: lemma eq_create_or_annihilate (φ : CreateAnnihilate) : φ = create ∨ φ = annihilate

entries.name: CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder
entries.docstring:
The normal ordering on creation and annihlation operators.
  Under this relation, `normalOrder a b` is false only if `a` is annihlate and `b` is create.
entries.snippet:
def normalOrder : CreateAnnihilate → CreateAnnihilate → Prop
  | create, _ => True
  | annihilate, annihilate => True
  | annihilate, create => False

entries.name: CreateAnnihilate.«instance@c7ee8ab0»
entries.docstring: The normal ordering on `CreateAnnihilate` is decidable.
entries.snippet:
instance : (φ φ' : CreateAnnihilate) → Decidable (normalOrder φ φ')
  | create, create => isTrue True.intro
  | annihilate, annihilate => isTrue True.intro
  | create, annihilate => isTrue True.intro
  | annihilate, create => isFalse False.elim

entries.name: CreateAnnihilate.«instance@8930f2e1»
entries.docstring: Normal ordering is total.
entries.snippet: instance : IsTotal CreateAnnihilate normalOrder where

entries.name: CreateAnnihilate.«instance@ce09efd2»
entries.docstring: Normal ordering is transitive.
entries.snippet: instance : IsTrans CreateAnnihilate normalOrder where

entries.name: CreateAnnihilate.not_normalOrder_annihilate_iff_false
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma not_normalOrder_annihilate_iff_false (a : CreateAnnihilate) :
    (¬ normalOrder a annihilate) ↔ False

entries.name: CreateAnnihilate.sum_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_eq {M : Type} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : CreateAnnihilate → M) :
    ∑ i, f i = f create + f annihilate

entries.name: CreateAnnihilate.CreateAnnihilate_card_eq_two
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma CreateAnnihilate_card_eq_two : Fintype.card CreateAnnihilate = 2

entries.name: FieldSpecification
entries.docstring:
A field specification is a type, `Fields`, elements of which are fields
  present in a theory, and a map `statistics` from `Fields` to `FieldStatistic` which
  identifies each field as a boson or a fermion.
entries.snippet:
structure FieldSpecification where
  Fields : Type
  statistics : Fields → FieldStatistic

entries.name: FieldSpecification.IncomingAsymptotic
entries.docstring: An incoming asymptotic state is a field and a momentum.
entries.snippet: def IncomingAsymptotic : Type

entries.name: FieldSpecification.OutgoingAsymptotic
entries.docstring: An outgoing asymptotic states is a field and a momentum.
entries.snippet: def OutgoingAsymptotic : Type

entries.name: FieldSpecification.PositionStates
entries.docstring: A position state is a field and a space-time position.
entries.snippet: def PositionStates : Type

entries.name: FieldSpecification.States
entries.docstring: The type States is the inductive type combining the asymptotic states and position states.
entries.snippet:
inductive States (𝓕 : FieldSpecification) where
  | inAsymp : 𝓕.IncomingAsymptotic → 𝓕.States
  | position : 𝓕.PositionStates → 𝓕.States
  | outAsymp : 𝓕.OutgoingAsymptotic → 𝓕.States

entries.name: FieldSpecification.statesToField
entries.docstring: Taking a state to its underlying field.
entries.snippet:
def statesToField : 𝓕.States → 𝓕.Fields
  | States.inAsymp φ => φ.1
  | States.position φ => φ.1
  | States.outAsymp φ => φ.1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.statesIsPosition
entries.docstring: The bool on `States` which is true only for position states.
entries.snippet:
def statesIsPosition : 𝓕.States → Bool
  | States.position _ => true
  | _ => false

entries.name: FieldSpecification.statesStatistic
entries.docstring: The statistics associated to a state.
entries.snippet: def statesStatistic : 𝓕.States → FieldStatistic

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection
entries.docstring:
The sections in `𝓕.CrAnStates` over a list `φs : List 𝓕.States`.
  In terms of physics, given some fields `φ₁...φₙ`, the different ways one can associate
  each field as a `creation` or an `annilation` operator. E.g. the number of terms
  `φ₁⁰φ₂¹...φₙ⁰` `φ₁¹φ₂¹...φₙ⁰` etc. If some fields are exclusively creation or annhilation
  operators at this point (e.g. ansymptotic states) this is accounted for.
entries.snippet: def CrAnSection (φs : List 𝓕.States) : Type

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.length_eq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma length_eq (ψs : CrAnSection φs) : ψs.1.length = φs.length

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.tail
entries.docstring: The tail of a section for `φs`.
entries.snippet:
def tail : {φs : List 𝓕.States} → (ψs : CrAnSection φs) → CrAnSection φs.tail
  | [], ⟨[], h⟩ => ⟨[], h⟩
  | φ :: φs, ⟨[], h⟩ => False.elim (by simp at h)
  | φ :: φs, ⟨ψ :: ψs, h⟩ => ⟨ψs, by rw [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at h; exact h.2⟩

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.head_state_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma head_state_eq {φ : 𝓕.States} : (ψs : CrAnSection (φ :: φs)) →
    (ψs.1.head (by simp [← List.length_pos_iff_ne_nil])).1 = φ
  | ⟨[], h⟩ => False.elim (by simp at h)
  | ⟨ψ :: ψs, h⟩ => by
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at h
    exact h.1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.statistics_eq_state_statistics
entries.snippet:
lemma statistics_eq_state_statistics (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    (𝓕 |>ₛ ψs.1) = 𝓕 |>ₛ φs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.take_statistics_eq_take_state_statistics
entries.snippet:
lemma take_statistics_eq_take_state_statistics (ψs : CrAnSection φs) n :
    (𝓕 |>ₛ (ψs.1.take n)) = 𝓕 |>ₛ (φs.take n)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.head
entries.docstring: The head of a section for `φ :: φs` as an element in `𝓕.statesToCreateAnnihilateType φ`.
entries.snippet:
def head : {φ : 𝓕.States} → (ψs : CrAnSection (φ :: φs)) →
    𝓕.statesToCrAnType φ
  | φ, ⟨[], h⟩ => False.elim (by simp at h)
  | φ, ⟨ψ :: ψs, h⟩ => 𝓕.statesToCreateAnnihilateTypeCongr (by
    simpa using head_state_eq ⟨ψ :: ψs, h⟩) ψ.2

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.eq_head_cons_tail
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_head_cons_tail {φ : 𝓕.States} {ψs : CrAnSection (φ :: φs)} :
    ψs.1 = ⟨φ, head ψs⟩ :: ψs.tail.1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.cons
entries.docstring:
The creation of a section from for `φ : φs` from a section for `φs` and a
  element of `𝓕.statesToCreateAnnihilateType φ`.
entries.snippet:
def cons {φ : 𝓕.States} (ψ : 𝓕.statesToCrAnType φ) (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    CrAnSection (φ :: φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.nilEquiv
entries.docstring:
For the empty list of states there is only one `CrAnSection`. Corresponding to the
  empty list of `CrAnStates`.
entries.snippet: def nilEquiv : CrAnSection (𝓕 := 𝓕) [] ≃ Unit where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.singletonEquiv
entries.docstring:
The creation and annihlation sections for a singleton list is given by
  a choice of `𝓕.statesToCreateAnnihilateType φ`. If `φ` is a asymptotic state
  there is no choice here, else there are two choices.
entries.snippet:
def singletonEquiv {φ : 𝓕.States} : CrAnSection [φ] ≃
    𝓕.statesToCrAnType φ where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.consEquiv
entries.docstring:
An equivalence seperating the head of a creation and annhilation section
  from the tail.
entries.snippet:
def consEquiv {φ : 𝓕.States} {φs : List 𝓕.States} : CrAnSection (φ :: φs) ≃
    𝓕.statesToCrAnType φ × CrAnSection φs where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.fintype
entries.docstring:
The instance of a finite type on `CrAnSection`s defined recursively through
  `consEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
instance fintype : (φs : List 𝓕.States) → Fintype (CrAnSection φs)
  | [] => Fintype.ofEquiv _ nilEquiv.symm
  | _ :: φs =>
    haveI : Fintype (CrAnSection φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.card_nil_eq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma card_nil_eq : Fintype.card (CrAnSection (𝓕 := 𝓕) []) = 1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.card_cons_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma card_cons_eq {φ : 𝓕.States} {φs : List 𝓕.States} :
    Fintype.card (CrAnSection (φ :: φs)) = Fintype.card (𝓕.statesToCrAnType φ) *
    Fintype.card (CrAnSection φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.card_eq_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma card_eq_mul : {φs : List 𝓕.States} → Fintype.card (CrAnSection φs) =
    2 ^ (List.countP 𝓕.statesIsPosition φs)
  | [] => by
    simp
  | States.position _ :: φs => by
      simp only [statesIsPosition, List.countP_cons_of_pos]
      rw [card_cons_eq]
      rw [card_eq_mul]
      simp only [statesToCrAnType, CreateAnnihilate.CreateAnnihilate_card_eq_two]
      ring
  | States.inAsymp x_ :: φs => by
      simp only [statesIsPosition, Bool.false_eq_true, not_false_eq_true, List.countP_cons_of_neg]
      rw [card_cons_eq]
      rw [card_eq_mul]
      simp [statesToCrAnType]
  | States.outAsymp _ :: φs => by
      simp only [statesIsPosition, Bool.false_eq_true, not_false_eq_true, List.countP_cons_of_neg]
      rw [card_cons_eq]
      rw [card_eq_mul]
      simp [statesToCrAnType]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.card_perm_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma card_perm_eq {φs φs' : List 𝓕.States} (h : φs.Perm φs') :
    Fintype.card (CrAnSection φs) = Fintype.card (CrAnSection φs')

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.sum_nil
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma sum_nil (f : CrAnSection (𝓕 := 𝓕) [] → M) [AddCommMonoid M] :
    ∑ (s : CrAnSection []), f s = f ⟨[], rfl⟩

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.sum_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_cons (f : CrAnSection (φ :: φs) → M) [AddCommMonoid M] :
    ∑ (s : CrAnSection (φ :: φs)), f s = ∑ (a : 𝓕.statesToCrAnType φ),
    ∑ (s : CrAnSection φs), f (cons a s)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.sum_over_length
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_over_length {s : CrAnSection φs} (f : Fin s.1.length → M)
    [AddCommMonoid M] : ∑ (n : Fin s.1.length), f n =
    ∑ (n : Fin φs.length), f (Fin.cast (length_eq s).symm n)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.congr
entries.docstring:
The equivalence between `CrAnSection φs` and
  `CrAnSection φs'` induced by an equality `φs = φs'`.
entries.snippet:
def congr : {φs φs' : List 𝓕.States} → (h : φs = φs') →
    CrAnSection φs ≃ CrAnSection φs'
  | _, _, rfl => Equiv.refl _

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.congr_fst
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma congr_fst {φs φs' : List 𝓕.States} (h : φs = φs') (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    (congr h ψs).1 = ψs.1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.congr_symm
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma congr_symm {φs φs' : List 𝓕.States} (h : φs = φs') :
    (congr h).symm = congr h.symm

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.congr_trans_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma congr_trans_apply {φs φs' φs'' : List 𝓕.States} (h1 : φs = φs') (h2 : φs' = φs'')
    (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    (congr h2 (congr h1 ψs)) = congr (by rw [h1, h2]) ψs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.take
entries.docstring: Returns the first `n` elements of a section and its underlying list.
entries.snippet: def take (n : ℕ) (ψs : CrAnSection φs) : CrAnSection (φs.take n)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.take_congr
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma take_congr {φs φs' : List 𝓕.States} (h : φs = φs') (n : ℕ)
    (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    (take n (congr h ψs)) = congr (by rw [h]) (take n ψs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.drop
entries.docstring: Removes the first `n` elements of a section and its underlying list.
entries.snippet: def drop (n : ℕ) (ψs : CrAnSection φs) : CrAnSection (φs.drop n)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.drop_congr
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma drop_congr {φs φs' : List 𝓕.States} (h : φs = φs') (n : ℕ)
    (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    (drop n (congr h ψs)) = congr (by rw [h]) (drop n ψs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.append
entries.docstring: Appends two sections and their underlying lists.
entries.snippet:
def append {φs φs' : List 𝓕.States} (ψs : CrAnSection φs)
    (ψs' : CrAnSection φs') : CrAnSection (φs ++ φs')

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.append_assoc
entries.snippet:
lemma append_assoc {φs φs' φs'' : List 𝓕.States} (ψs : CrAnSection φs)
    (ψs' : CrAnSection φs') (ψs'' : CrAnSection φs'') :
    append ψs (append ψs' ψs'') = congr (by simp) (append (append ψs ψs') ψs'')

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.append_assoc'
entries.snippet:
lemma append_assoc' {φs φs' φs'' : List 𝓕.States} (ψs : CrAnSection φs)
    (ψs' : CrAnSection φs') (ψs'' : CrAnSection φs'') :
    (append (append ψs ψs') ψs'') = congr (by simp) (append ψs (append ψs' ψs''))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.singletonEquiv_append_eq_cons
FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.take_append_drop
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma take_append_drop {n : ℕ} (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    append (take n ψs) (drop n ψs) = congr (List.take_append_drop n φs).symm ψs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.congr_append
entries.snippet:
lemma congr_append {φs1 φs1' φs2 φs2' : List 𝓕.States} (h1 : φs1 = φs1') (h2 : φs2 = φs2')
    (ψs1 : CrAnSection φs1) (ψs2 : CrAnSection φs2) :
    (append (congr h1 ψs1) (congr h2 ψs2)) = congr (by rw [h1, h2]) (append ψs1 ψs2)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.congr_fst_append
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma congr_fst_append {φs1 φs1' φs2 : List 𝓕.States} (h1 : φs1 = φs1')
    (ψs1 : CrAnSection φs1) (ψs2 : CrAnSection φs2) :
    (append (congr h1 ψs1) (ψs2)) = congr (by rw [h1]) (append ψs1 ψs2)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.congr_snd_append
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma congr_snd_append {φs1 φs2 φs2' : List 𝓕.States} (h2 : φs2 = φs2')
    (ψs1 : CrAnSection φs1) (ψs2 : CrAnSection φs2) :
    (append ψs1 (congr h2 ψs2)) = congr (by rw [h2]) (append ψs1 ψs2)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.take_left
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma take_left {φs φs' : List 𝓕.States} (ψs : CrAnSection φs)
    (ψs' : CrAnSection φs') :
    take φs.length (ψs.append ψs') = congr (by simp) ψs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.drop_left
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma drop_left {φs φs' : List 𝓕.States} (ψs : CrAnSection φs)
    (ψs' : CrAnSection φs') :
    drop φs.length (ψs.append ψs') = congr (by simp) ψs'

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.appendEquiv
entries.docstring:
The equivalence between `CrAnSection (φs ++ φs')` and
  `CrAnSection φs × CrAnSection φs` formed by `append`, `take`
  and `drop` and their interrelationship.
entries.snippet:
def appendEquiv {φs φs' : List 𝓕.States} : CrAnSection (φs ++ φs') ≃
    CrAnSection φs × CrAnSection φs' where

entries.name: List.map_eraseIdx
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma _root_.List.map_eraseIdx {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : (l : List α) → (n : ℕ) →
    List.map f (l.eraseIdx n) = (List.map f l).eraseIdx n
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, 0 => rfl
  | a :: l, n+1 => by
    simp only [List.eraseIdx, List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
    exact List.map_eraseIdx f l n

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.eraseIdx
entries.docstring: Erasing an element from a section and it's underlying list.
entries.snippet: def eraseIdx (n : ℕ) (ψs : CrAnSection φs) : CrAnSection (φs.eraseIdx n)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.eraseIdxEquiv
entries.docstring: The equivalence formed by extracting an element from a section.

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.eraseIdxEquiv_apply_snd
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma eraseIdxEquiv_apply_snd {n : ℕ} (ψs : CrAnSection φs) (hn : n < φs.length) :
    (eraseIdxEquiv n φs hn ψs).snd = eraseIdx n ψs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.eraseIdxEquiv_symm_eq_take_cons_drop
entries.snippet:
lemma eraseIdxEquiv_symm_eq_take_cons_drop {n : ℕ} (φs : List 𝓕.States) (hn : n < φs.length)
    (a : 𝓕.statesToCrAnType φs[n]) (s : CrAnSection (φs.eraseIdx n)) :
    (eraseIdxEquiv n φs hn).symm ⟨a, s⟩ =
    congr (by
    rw [HepLean.List.take_eraseIdx_same, HepLean.List.drop_eraseIdx_succ]
    conv_rhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop n φs]) (append (take n s) (cons a (drop n s)))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.eraseIdxEquiv_symm_getElem
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma eraseIdxEquiv_symm_getElem {n : ℕ} (φs : List 𝓕.States) (hn : n < φs.length)
    (a : 𝓕.statesToCrAnType φs[n]) (s : CrAnSection (φs.eraseIdx n)) :
    getElem ((eraseIdxEquiv n φs hn).symm ⟨a,s⟩).1 n
    (by rw [length_eq]; exact hn) = ⟨φs[n], a⟩

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.eraseIdxEquiv_symm_eraseIdx
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma eraseIdxEquiv_symm_eraseIdx {n : ℕ} (φs : List 𝓕.States) (hn : n < φs.length)
    (a : 𝓕.statesToCrAnType φs[n]) (s : CrAnSection (φs.eraseIdx n)) :
    ((eraseIdxEquiv n φs hn).symm ⟨a, s⟩).1.eraseIdx n = s.1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnSection.sum_eraseIdxEquiv
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_eraseIdxEquiv (n : ℕ) (φs : List 𝓕.States) (hn : n < φs.length)
    (f : CrAnSection φs → M) [AddCommMonoid M] : ∑ (s : CrAnSection φs), f s =
    ∑ (a : 𝓕.statesToCrAnType φs[n]), ∑ (s : CrAnSection (φs.eraseIdx n)),
    f ((eraseIdxEquiv n φs hn).symm ⟨a, s⟩)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.statesToCrAnType
entries.docstring:
To each state the specificaition of the type of creation and annihlation parts.
  For asymptotic staes there is only one allowed part, whilst for position states
  there is two.
entries.snippet:
def statesToCrAnType : 𝓕.States → Type
  | States.inAsymp _ => Unit
  | States.position _ => CreateAnnihilate
  | States.outAsymp _ => Unit

entries.name: FieldSpecification.«instance@18235157»
entries.docstring: The instance of a finite type on `𝓕.statesToCreateAnnihilateType i`.
entries.snippet: instance : ∀ i, Fintype (𝓕.statesToCrAnType i)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.«instance@7bee767f»
entries.docstring: The instance of a decidable equality on `𝓕.statesToCreateAnnihilateType i`.
entries.snippet: instance : ∀ i, DecidableEq (𝓕.statesToCrAnType i)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.statesToCreateAnnihilateTypeCongr
entries.docstring:
The equivalence between `𝓕.statesToCreateAnnihilateType i` and
  `𝓕.statesToCreateAnnihilateType j` from an equality `i = j`.
entries.snippet:
def statesToCreateAnnihilateTypeCongr : {i j : 𝓕.States} → i = j →
    𝓕.statesToCrAnType i ≃ 𝓕.statesToCrAnType j
  | _, _, rfl => Equiv.refl _

entries.name: FieldSpecification.CrAnStates
entries.docstring:
A creation and annihlation state is a state plus an valid specification of the
  creation or annihliation part of that state. (For asympotic states there is only one valid
  choice).
entries.snippet: def CrAnStates : Type

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnStatesToStates
entries.docstring: The map from creation and annihlation states to their underlying states.
entries.snippet: def crAnStatesToStates : 𝓕.CrAnStates → 𝓕.States

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnStatesToStates_prod
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma crAnStatesToStates_prod (s : 𝓕.States) (t : 𝓕.statesToCrAnType s) :
    𝓕.crAnStatesToStates ⟨s, t⟩ = s

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnStatesToCreateAnnihilate
entries.docstring:
The map from creation and annihlation states to the type `CreateAnnihilate`
  specifying if a state is a creation or an annihilation state.
entries.snippet:
def crAnStatesToCreateAnnihilate : 𝓕.CrAnStates → CreateAnnihilate
  | ⟨States.inAsymp _, _⟩ => CreateAnnihilate.create
  | ⟨States.position _, CreateAnnihilate.create⟩ => CreateAnnihilate.create
  | ⟨States.position _, CreateAnnihilate.annihilate⟩ => CreateAnnihilate.annihilate
  | ⟨States.outAsymp _, _⟩ => CreateAnnihilate.annihilate

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnStatistics
entries.docstring: Takes a `CrAnStates` state to its corresponding fields statistic (bosonic or fermionic).
entries.snippet: def crAnStatistics : 𝓕.CrAnStates → FieldStatistic

entries.name: FieldSpecification.singleBoson
entries.docstring:
The Field specification corresponding to a single bosonic field.
  The type of fields is the unit type, and the statistic of the unique element of the unit
  type is bosonic.
entries.snippet: def singleBoson : FieldSpecification where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.singleFermion
entries.docstring:
The Field specification corresponding to a single fermionic field.
  The type of fields is the unit type, and the statistic of the unique element of the unit
  type is fermionic.
entries.snippet: def singleFermion : FieldSpecification where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.doubleBosonDoubleFermion
entries.docstring:
The Field specification corresponding to two bosonic fields and two fermionic fields.
  The type of fields is `Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2`, and the statistic of the two `.inl` (left) elements
  is bosonic and the statistic of the two `.inr` (right) elements is fermionic.
entries.snippet: def doubleBosonDoubleFermion : FieldSpecification where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.createFilter
entries.docstring:
Given a list of creation and annihilation states, the filtered list only containing
  the creation states. As a schematic example, for the list:
  - `[φ1c, φ1a, φ2c, φ2a]` this will return `[φ1c, φ2c]`.
entries.snippet: def createFilter (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) : List 𝓕.CrAnStates

entries.name: FieldSpecification.createFilter_cons_create
FieldSpecification.createFilter_cons_annihilate
FieldSpecification.createFilter_append
entries.snippet:
lemma createFilter_append (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    createFilter (φs ++ φs') = createFilter φs ++ createFilter φs'

entries.name: FieldSpecification.createFilter_singleton_create
entries.snippet:
lemma createFilter_singleton_create (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.create) :
    createFilter [φ] = [φ]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.createFilter_singleton_annihilate
entries.snippet:
lemma createFilter_singleton_annihilate (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) : createFilter [φ] = []

entries.name: FieldSpecification.annihilateFilter
entries.docstring:
Given a list of creation and annihilation states, the filtered list only containing
  the annihilation states.
  As a schematic example, for the list:
  - `[φ1c, φ1a, φ2c, φ2a]` this will return `[φ1a, φ2a]`.
entries.snippet: def annihilateFilter (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) : List 𝓕.CrAnStates

entries.name: FieldSpecification.annihilateFilter_cons_create
FieldSpecification.annihilateFilter_cons_annihilate
FieldSpecification.annihilateFilter_append
entries.snippet:
lemma annihilateFilter_append (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    annihilateFilter (φs ++ φs') = annihilateFilter φs ++ annihilateFilter φs'

entries.name: FieldSpecification.annihilateFilter_singleton_create
entries.snippet:
lemma annihilateFilter_singleton_create (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.create) :
    annihilateFilter [φ] = []

entries.name: FieldSpecification.annihilateFilter_singleton_annihilate
entries.snippet:
lemma annihilateFilter_singleton_annihilate (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) :
    annihilateFilter [φ] = [φ]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderRel
entries.docstring:
The normal ordering relation on creation and annihlation operators.
  For a list of creation and annihlation states, this relation is designed
  to move all creation states to the left, and all annihlation operators to the right.
  We have that `normalOrderRel φ1 φ2` is true if
  - `φ1` is a creation operator
  or
  - `φ2` is an annihlate operator.
entries.snippet: def normalOrderRel : 𝓕.CrAnStates → 𝓕.CrAnStates → Prop

entries.name: FieldSpecification.«instance@b27dc842»
entries.docstring: Normal ordering is total.
entries.snippet: instance : IsTotal 𝓕.CrAnStates 𝓕.normalOrderRel where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.«instance@8c7b117c»
entries.docstring: Normal ordering is transitive.
entries.snippet: instance : IsTrans 𝓕.CrAnStates 𝓕.normalOrderRel where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.«instance@57fcbe74»
entries.docstring: A decidable instance on the normal ordering relation.
entries.snippet: instance (φ φ' : 𝓕.CrAnStates) : Decidable (normalOrderRel φ φ')

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderSign
entries.docstring:
The sign associated with putting a list of creation and annihlation states into normal order
  (with the creation operators on the left).
  We pick up a minus sign for every fermion paired crossed.
entries.snippet: def normalOrderSign (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) : ℂ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderSign_mul_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalOrderSign_mul_self (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    normalOrderSign φs * normalOrderSign φs = 1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.koszulSignInsert_create
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_create (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.create) : (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) →
    Wick.koszulSignInsert 𝓕.crAnStatistics normalOrderRel φ φs = 1
  | [] => rfl
  | φ' :: φs => by
    dsimp only [Wick.koszulSignInsert]
    rw [if_pos]
    · exact koszulSignInsert_create φ hφ φs
    · dsimp only [normalOrderRel]
      rw [hφ]
      dsimp [CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderSign_cons_create
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderSign_cons_create (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.create) (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    normalOrderSign (φ :: φs) = normalOrderSign φs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderSign_singleton
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalOrderSign_singleton (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates) : normalOrderSign [φ] = 1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderSign_nil
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalOrderSign_nil : normalOrderSign (𝓕 := 𝓕) [] = 1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.koszulSignInsert_append_annihilate
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_append_annihilate (φ' φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) :
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) →
    Wick.koszulSignInsert 𝓕.crAnStatistics normalOrderRel φ' (φs ++ [φ]) =
    Wick.koszulSignInsert 𝓕.crAnStatistics normalOrderRel φ' φs
  | [] => by
    simp only [Wick.koszulSignInsert, normalOrderRel, hφ, ite_eq_left_iff,
      CreateAnnihilate.not_normalOrder_annihilate_iff_false, ite_eq_right_iff, and_imp,
      IsEmpty.forall_iff]
  | φ'' :: φs => by
    dsimp only [List.cons_append, Wick.koszulSignInsert]
    rw [koszulSignInsert_append_annihilate φ' φ hφ φs]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderSign_append_annihlate
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderSign_append_annihlate (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) :
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) →
    normalOrderSign (φs ++ [φ]) = normalOrderSign φs
  | [] => by simp
  | φ' :: φs => by
    dsimp only [List.cons_append, normalOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign]
    have hi

entries.name: FieldSpecification.koszulSignInsert_annihilate_cons_create
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_annihilate_cons_create (φc φa : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create)
    (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    Wick.koszulSignInsert 𝓕.crAnStatistics normalOrderRel φa (φc :: φs)
    = FieldStatistic.exchangeSign (𝓕.crAnStatistics φc) (𝓕.crAnStatistics φa) *
    Wick.koszulSignInsert 𝓕.crAnStatistics normalOrderRel φa φs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderSign_swap_create_annihlate_fst
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderSign_swap_create_annihlate_fst (φc φa : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create)
    (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    normalOrderSign (φc :: φa :: φs) =
    FieldStatistic.exchangeSign (𝓕.crAnStatistics φc) (𝓕.crAnStatistics φa) *
    normalOrderSign (φa :: φc :: φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.koszulSignInsert_swap
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_swap (φ φc φa : 𝓕.CrAnStates) (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    Wick.koszulSignInsert 𝓕.crAnStatistics normalOrderRel φ (φs ++ φa :: φc :: φs')
    = Wick.koszulSignInsert 𝓕.crAnStatistics normalOrderRel φ (φs ++ φc :: φa :: φs')

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderSign_swap_create_annihlate
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderSign_swap_create_annihlate (φc φa : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create) (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) :
    (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) → normalOrderSign (φs ++ φc :: φa :: φs') =
    FieldStatistic.exchangeSign (𝓕.crAnStatistics φc) (𝓕.crAnStatistics φa) *
    normalOrderSign (φs ++ φa :: φc :: φs')
  | [], φs' => normalOrderSign_swap_create_annihlate_fst φc φa hφc hφa φs'
  | φ :: φs, φs' => by
    rw [normalOrderSign]
    dsimp only [List.cons_append, Wick.koszulSign, FieldStatistic.instCommGroup.eq_1]
    rw [← normalOrderSign, normalOrderSign_swap_create_annihlate φc φa hφc hφa φs φs']
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (FieldStatistic.exchangeSign _ _), mul_assoc]
    simp only [FieldStatistic.instCommGroup.eq_1, mul_eq_mul_left_iff]
    apply Or.inl
    conv_rhs => rw [normalOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign, ← normalOrderSign]
    simp only [mul_eq_mul_right_iff]
    left
    rw [koszulSignInsert_swap]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderSign_swap_create_create_fst
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderSign_swap_create_create_fst (φc φc' : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create) (hφc' : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc' = CreateAnnihilate.create)
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    normalOrderSign (φc :: φc' :: φs) = normalOrderSign (φc' :: φc :: φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderSign_swap_create_create
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderSign_swap_create_create (φc φc' : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create) (hφc' : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc' = CreateAnnihilate.create) :
    (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) →
    normalOrderSign (φs ++ φc :: φc' :: φs') = normalOrderSign (φs ++ φc' :: φc :: φs')
  | [], φs' => by
    exact normalOrderSign_swap_create_create_fst φc φc' hφc hφc' φs'
  | φ :: φs, φs' => by
    rw [normalOrderSign]
    dsimp only [List.cons_append, Wick.koszulSign]
    rw [← normalOrderSign, normalOrderSign_swap_create_create φc φc' hφc hφc']
    dsimp only [normalOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign]
    rw [← normalOrderSign]
    simp only [mul_eq_mul_right_iff]
    apply Or.inl (Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_perm _ _ _ _ _ _)
    exact List.Perm.append_left φs (List.Perm.swap φc' φc φs')

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderSign_swap_annihilate_annihilate_fst
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderSign_swap_annihilate_annihilate_fst (φa φa' : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (hφa' : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa' = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    normalOrderSign (φa :: φa' :: φs) =
    normalOrderSign (φa' :: φa :: φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderSign_swap_annihilate_annihilate
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderSign_swap_annihilate_annihilate (φa φa' : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (hφa' : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa' = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) : (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) →
    normalOrderSign (φs ++ φa :: φa' :: φs') = normalOrderSign (φs ++ φa' :: φa :: φs')
  | [], φs' => by
    exact normalOrderSign_swap_annihilate_annihilate_fst φa φa' hφa hφa' φs'
  | φ :: φs, φs' => by
    rw [normalOrderSign]
    dsimp only [List.cons_append, Wick.koszulSign]
    rw [← normalOrderSign]
    rw [normalOrderSign_swap_annihilate_annihilate φa φa' hφa hφa']
    dsimp only [normalOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign]
    rw [← normalOrderSign]
    simp only [mul_eq_mul_right_iff]
    apply Or.inl
    apply Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_perm
    refine List.Perm.append_left φs ?h.h.a
    exact List.Perm.swap φa' φa φs'
open FieldStatistic

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderList
entries.docstring:
The normal ordering of a list of creation and annihilation states.
  To give some schematic. For example:
  - `normalOrderList [φ1c, φ1a, φ2c, φ2a] = [φ1c, φ2c, φ1a, φ2a]`
entries.snippet: def normalOrderList (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) : List 𝓕.CrAnStates

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderList_nil
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalOrderList_nil : normalOrderList (𝓕 := 𝓕) [] = []

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderList_statistics
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalOrderList_statistics (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    (𝓕 |>ₛ (normalOrderList φs)) = 𝓕 |>ₛ φs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.orderedInsert_create
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsert_create (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.create) :
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) → List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ φs = φ :: φs
  | [] => rfl
  | φ' :: φs => by
    dsimp only [List.orderedInsert.eq_2]
    rw [if_pos]
    dsimp only [normalOrderRel]
    rw [hφ]
    dsimp [CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderList_cons_create
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderList_cons_create (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.create) (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    normalOrderList (φ :: φs) = φ :: normalOrderList φs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.orderedInsert_append_annihilate
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsert_append_annihilate (φ' φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) :
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) → List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ' (φs ++ [φ]) =
    List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ' φs ++ [φ]
  | [] => by
    simp [Wick.koszulSignInsert, normalOrderRel, hφ]
  | φ'' :: φs => by
    dsimp only [List.cons_append, List.orderedInsert.eq_2]
    have hi

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderList_append_annihilate
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderList_append_annihilate (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) :
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) →
    normalOrderList (φs ++ [φ]) = normalOrderList φs ++ [φ]
  | [] => by simp [normalOrderList]
  | φ' :: φs => by
    simp only [normalOrderList, List.insertionSort, List.append_eq]
    have hi

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrder_swap_create_annihlate_fst
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrder_swap_create_annihlate_fst (φc φa : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create)
    (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    normalOrderList (φc :: φa :: φs) = normalOrderList (φa :: φc :: φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderList_swap_create_annihlate
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderList_swap_create_annihlate (φc φa : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create)
    (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) :
    (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) →
    normalOrderList (φs ++ φc :: φa :: φs') = normalOrderList (φs ++ φa :: φc :: φs')
  | [], φs' => normalOrder_swap_create_annihlate_fst φc φa hφc hφa φs'
  | φ :: φs, φs' => by
    dsimp only [List.cons_append, normalOrderList, List.insertionSort]
    have hi

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderEquiv
entries.docstring:
For a list of creation and annihlation states, the equivalence between
  `Fin φs.length` and `Fin (normalOrderList φs).length` taking each position in `φs`
  to it's corresponding position in the normal ordered list. This assumes that
  we are using the insertion sort method.
  For example:
  - For `[φ1c, φ1a, φ2c, φ2a]` this equivalence sends `0 ↦ 0`, `1 ↦ 2`, `2 ↦ 1`, `3 ↦ 3`.
entries.snippet: def normalOrderEquiv {φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates} : Fin φs.length ≃ Fin (normalOrderList φs).length

entries.name: FieldSpecification.sum_normalOrderList_length
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_normalOrderList_length {M : Type} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) (f : Fin (normalOrderList φs).length → M) :
    ∑ (n : Fin (normalOrderList φs).length), f n = ∑ (n : Fin φs.length), f (normalOrderEquiv n)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderList_get_normalOrderEquiv
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalOrderList_get_normalOrderEquiv {φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates} (n : Fin φs.length) :
    (normalOrderList φs)[(normalOrderEquiv n).val] = φs[n.val]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderList_eraseIdx_normalOrderEquiv
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalOrderList_eraseIdx_normalOrderEquiv {φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates} (n : Fin φs.length) :
    (normalOrderList φs).eraseIdx (normalOrderEquiv n).val =
    normalOrderList (φs.eraseIdx n.val)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderSign_eraseIdx
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderSign_eraseIdx (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) (n : Fin φs.length) :
    normalOrderSign (φs.eraseIdx n) = normalOrderSign φs *
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ (φs.get n), 𝓕 |>ₛ (φs.take n)) *
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ (φs.get n), 𝓕 |>ₛ ((normalOrderList φs).take (normalOrderEquiv n)))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilate
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilate (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) : (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) →
    List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ (createFilter φs ++ φs') =
    createFilter φs ++ List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ φs'
  | [], φs' => by simp [createFilter]
  | φ' :: φs, φs' => by
    rcases CreateAnnihilate.eq_create_or_annihilate (𝓕 |>ᶜ φ') with hφ' | hφ'
    · rw [createFilter_cons_create hφ']
      dsimp only [List.cons_append, List.orderedInsert.eq_2]
      rw [if_neg, orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilate φ hφ φs φs']
      simp [normalOrderRel, hφ, hφ', CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder]
    · rw [createFilter_cons_annihilate hφ', orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilate φ hφ φs]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.orderedInsert_annihilateFilter
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsert_annihilateFilter (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates) : (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) →
    List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ (annihilateFilter φs) =
    φ :: annihilateFilter φs
  | [] => by simp [annihilateFilter]
  | φ' :: φs => by
    rcases CreateAnnihilate.eq_create_or_annihilate (𝓕 |>ᶜ φ') with hφ' | hφ'
    · rw [annihilateFilter_cons_create hφ', orderedInsert_annihilateFilter φ φs]
    · rw [annihilateFilter_cons_annihilate hφ']
      dsimp only [List.orderedInsert.eq_2]
      rw [if_pos]
      dsimp only [normalOrderRel]
      rw [hφ']
      rcases CreateAnnihilate.eq_create_or_annihilate (𝓕 |>ᶜ φ) with hφ | hφ
      · rw [hφ]
        simp only [CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder]
      · rw [hφ]
        simp [CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter_annihilate
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter_annihilate (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ (createFilter φs ++ annihilateFilter φs) =
    createFilter φs ++ φ :: annihilateFilter φs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrderList_eq_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrderList_eq_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter : (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) →
    normalOrderList φs = createFilter φs ++ annihilateFilter φs
  | [] => by simp [normalOrderList, createFilter, annihilateFilter]
  | φ :: φs => by
    by_cases hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.create
    · rw [normalOrderList_cons_create φ hφ φs]
      dsimp only [createFilter]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_pos]
      swap
      simp only [hφ, decide_true]
      dsimp only [annihilateFilter, List.cons_append]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_neg]
      swap
      simp only [hφ, reduceCtorEq, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, not_false_eq_true]
      rw [normalOrderList_eq_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter φs]
      rfl
    · dsimp only [normalOrderList, List.insertionSort]
      rw [← normalOrderList]
      have hφ' : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate

entries.name: FieldSpecification.timeOrderRel
entries.docstring:
The time ordering relation on states. We have that `timeOrderRel φ0 φ1` is true
  if and only if `φ1` has a time less-then or equal to `φ0`, or `φ1` is a negative
  asymptotic state, or `φ0` is a positive asymptotic state.
entries.snippet:
def timeOrderRel : 𝓕.States → 𝓕.States → Prop
  | States.outAsymp _, _ => True
  | States.position φ0, States.position φ1 => φ1.2 0 ≤ φ0.2 0
  | States.position _, States.inAsymp _ => True
  | States.position _, States.outAsymp _ => False
  | States.inAsymp _, States.outAsymp _ => False
  | States.inAsymp _, States.position _ => False
  | States.inAsymp _, States.inAsymp _ => True

entries.name: FieldSpecification.«instance@2f267e5d»
entries.docstring:
The relation `timeOrderRel` is decidable, but not computablly so due to
  `Real.decidableLE`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable instance : (φ φ' : 𝓕.States) → Decidable (timeOrderRel φ φ')
  | States.outAsymp _, _ => isTrue True.intro
  | States.position φ0, States.position φ1 => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (φ1.2 0 ≤ φ0.2 0))
  | States.position _, States.inAsymp _ => isTrue True.intro
  | States.position _, States.outAsymp _ => isFalse (fun a => a)
  | States.inAsymp _, States.outAsymp _ => isFalse (fun a => a)
  | States.inAsymp _, States.position _ => isFalse (fun a => a)
  | States.inAsymp _, States.inAsymp _ => isTrue True.intro

entries.name: FieldSpecification.«instance@cd3512eb»
entries.docstring: Time ordering is total.
entries.snippet: instance : IsTotal 𝓕.States 𝓕.timeOrderRel where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.«instance@3c5b3f7c»
entries.docstring: Time ordering is transitive.
entries.snippet: instance : IsTrans 𝓕.States 𝓕.timeOrderRel where

entries.name: FieldSpecification.maxTimeFieldPos
entries.docstring:
Given a list `φ :: φs` of states, the (zero-based) position of the state which is
  of maximum time. For example
  - for the list `[φ1(t = 4), φ2(t = 5), φ3(t = 3), φ4(t = 5)]` this would return `1`.
  This is defined for a list `φ :: φs` instead of `φs` to ensure that such a position exists.
entries.snippet: def maxTimeFieldPos (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) : ℕ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.maxTimeFieldPos_lt_length
entries.snippet:
lemma maxTimeFieldPos_lt_length (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) :
    maxTimeFieldPos φ φs < (φ :: φs).length

entries.name: FieldSpecification.maxTimeField
entries.docstring:
Given a list `φ :: φs` of states, the left-most state of maximum time, if there are more.
  As an example:
  - for the list `[φ1(t = 4), φ2(t = 5), φ3(t = 3), φ4(t = 5)]` this would return `φ2(t = 5)`.
  It is the state at the position `maxTimeFieldPos φ φs`.
entries.snippet: def maxTimeField (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) : 𝓕.States

entries.name: FieldSpecification.eraseMaxTimeField
entries.docstring:
Given a list `φ :: φs` of states, the list with the left-most state of maximum
  time removed.
  As an example:
  - for the list `[φ1(t = 4), φ2(t = 5), φ3(t = 3), φ4(t = 5)]` this would return
    `[φ1(t = 4), φ3(t = 3), φ4(t = 5)]`.
entries.snippet: def eraseMaxTimeField (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) : List 𝓕.States

entries.name: FieldSpecification.eraseMaxTimeField_length
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma eraseMaxTimeField_length (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) :
    (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs).length = φs.length

entries.name: FieldSpecification.maxTimeFieldPos_lt_eraseMaxTimeField_length_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma maxTimeFieldPos_lt_eraseMaxTimeField_length_succ (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) :
    maxTimeFieldPos φ φs < (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs).length.succ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.maxTimeFieldPosFin
entries.docstring:
Given a list `φ :: φs` of states, the position of the left-most state of maximum
  time as an eement of `Fin (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs).length.succ`.
  As an example:
  - for the list `[φ1(t = 4), φ2(t = 5), φ3(t = 3), φ4(t = 5)]` this would return `⟨1,...⟩`.
entries.snippet:
def maxTimeFieldPosFin (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) :
    Fin (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs).length.succ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.lt_maxTimeFieldPosFin_not_timeOrder
entries.snippet:
lemma lt_maxTimeFieldPosFin_not_timeOrder (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (i : Fin (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs).length)
    (hi : (maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs).succAbove i < maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs) :
    ¬ timeOrderRel ((eraseMaxTimeField φ φs)[i.val]) (maxTimeField φ φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.timeOrder_maxTimeField
entries.snippet:
lemma timeOrder_maxTimeField (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (i : Fin (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs).length) :
    timeOrderRel (maxTimeField φ φs) ((eraseMaxTimeField φ φs)[i.val])

entries.name: FieldSpecification.timeOrderSign
entries.docstring:
The sign associated with putting a list of states into time order (with
  the state of greatest time to the left).
  We pick up a minus sign for every fermion paired crossed.
entries.snippet: def timeOrderSign (φs : List 𝓕.States) : ℂ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.timeOrderSign_nil
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma timeOrderSign_nil : timeOrderSign (𝓕 := 𝓕) [] = 1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.timeOrderSign_pair_ordered
entries.snippet:
lemma timeOrderSign_pair_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.States} (h : timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    timeOrderSign [φ, ψ] = 1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.timeOrderSign_pair_not_ordered
entries.snippet:
lemma timeOrderSign_pair_not_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.States} (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    timeOrderSign [φ, ψ] = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.timerOrderSign_of_eraseMaxTimeField
entries.snippet:
lemma timerOrderSign_of_eraseMaxTimeField (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) :
    timeOrderSign (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs) = timeOrderSign (φ :: φs) *
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ maxTimeField φ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ (φ :: φs).take (maxTimeFieldPos φ φs))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.timeOrderList
entries.docstring:
The time ordering of a list of states. A schematic example is:
  - `normalOrderList [φ1(t = 4), φ2(t = 5), φ3(t = 3), φ4(t = 5)]` is equal to
    `[φ2(t = 5), φ4(t = 5), φ1(t = 4), φ3(t = 3)]`
entries.snippet: def timeOrderList (φs : List 𝓕.States) : List 𝓕.States

entries.name: FieldSpecification.timeOrderList_pair_ordered
entries.snippet:
lemma timeOrderList_pair_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.States} (h : timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    timeOrderList [φ, ψ] = [φ, ψ]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.timeOrderList_pair_not_ordered
entries.snippet:
lemma timeOrderList_pair_not_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.States} (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    timeOrderList [φ, ψ] = [ψ, φ]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.timeOrderList_nil
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma timeOrderList_nil : timeOrderList (𝓕 := 𝓕) [] = []

entries.name: FieldSpecification.timeOrderList_eq_maxTimeField_timeOrderList
entries.snippet:
lemma timeOrderList_eq_maxTimeField_timeOrderList (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) :
    timeOrderList (φ :: φs) = maxTimeField φ φs :: timeOrderList (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnTimeOrderRel
entries.docstring: The time ordering relation on CrAnStates.
entries.snippet: def crAnTimeOrderRel (a b : 𝓕.CrAnStates) : Prop

entries.name: FieldSpecification.«instance@346267bb»
entries.docstring:
The relation `crAnTimeOrderRel` is decidable, but not computablly so due to
  `Real.decidableLE`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance (φ φ' : 𝓕.CrAnStates) : Decidable (crAnTimeOrderRel φ φ')

entries.name: FieldSpecification.«instance@c677c23f»
entries.docstring: Time ordering of `CrAnStates` is total.

entries.name: FieldSpecification.«instance@914d97fe»

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnTimeOrderRel_refl
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma crAnTimeOrderRel_refl (φ : 𝓕.CrAnStates) : crAnTimeOrderRel φ φ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnTimeOrderSign
entries.docstring:
The sign associated with putting a list of `CrAnStates` into time order (with
  the state of greatest time to the left).
  We pick up a minus sign for every fermion paired crossed.
entries.snippet: def crAnTimeOrderSign (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) : ℂ

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnTimeOrderSign_nil
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma crAnTimeOrderSign_nil : crAnTimeOrderSign (𝓕 := 𝓕) [] = 1

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnTimeOrderSign_pair_ordered
entries.snippet:
lemma crAnTimeOrderSign_pair_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnStates} (h : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) :

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnTimeOrderSign_pair_not_ordered
entries.snippet:
lemma crAnTimeOrderSign_pair_not_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnStates} (h : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) :

FieldSpecification.crAnTimeOrderList
entries.docstring: Sort a list of `CrAnStates` based on `crAnTimeOrderRel`.
entries.snippet: def crAnTimeOrderList (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) : List 𝓕.CrAnStates

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnTimeOrderList_nil
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma crAnTimeOrderList_nil : crAnTimeOrderList (𝓕 := 𝓕) [] = []

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnTimeOrderList_pair_ordered
entries.snippet:
lemma crAnTimeOrderList_pair_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnStates} (h : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    crAnTimeOrderList [φ, ψ] = [φ, ψ]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnTimeOrderList_pair_not_ordered
entries.snippet:
lemma crAnTimeOrderList_pair_not_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnStates} (h : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    crAnTimeOrderList [φ, ψ] = [ψ, φ]

entries.name: FieldSpecification.orderedInsert_swap_eq_time
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsert_swap_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnStates}
    (h1 : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (h2 : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) :
    List.orderedInsert crAnTimeOrderRel φ (List.orderedInsert crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φs) =
    List.takeWhile (fun b => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel ψ b) φs ++ φ :: ψ ::
    List.dropWhile (fun b => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel ψ b) φs

entries.name: FieldSpecification.orderedInsert_in_swap_eq_time
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsert_in_swap_eq_time {φ ψ φ': 𝓕.CrAnStates} (h1 : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ)
    (h2 : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) : (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) → ∃ l1 l2,
    List.orderedInsert crAnTimeOrderRel φ' (φs ++ φ :: ψ :: φs') = l1 ++ φ :: ψ :: l2 ∧
    List.orderedInsert crAnTimeOrderRel φ' (φs ++ ψ :: φ :: φs') = l1 ++ ψ :: φ :: l2
  | [], φs' => by
    have h1 (b : 𝓕.CrAnStates) : (crAnTimeOrderRel b φ) ↔ (crAnTimeOrderRel b ψ)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnTimeOrderList_swap_eq_time
entries.snippet:
lemma crAnTimeOrderList_swap_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnStates}
    (h1 : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (h2 : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) :
    (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnStates) →
    ∃ (l1 l2 : List 𝓕.CrAnStates),
      crAnTimeOrderList (φs ++ φ :: ψ :: φs') = l1 ++ φ :: ψ :: l2 ∧
      crAnTimeOrderList (φs ++ ψ :: φ :: φs') = l1 ++ ψ :: φ :: l2
  | [], φs' => by
    simp only [crAnTimeOrderList]
    simp only [List.insertionSort]
    use List.takeWhile (fun b => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel ψ b) (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel φs'),
      List.dropWhile (fun b => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel ψ b) (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel φs')
    apply And.intro
    · exact orderedInsert_swap_eq_time h1 h2 _
    · have h1' (b : 𝓕.CrAnStates) : (crAnTimeOrderRel φ b) ↔ (crAnTimeOrderRel ψ b)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.koszulSignInsert_crAnTimeOrderRel_crAnSection
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_crAnTimeOrderRel_crAnSection {φ : 𝓕.States} {ψ : 𝓕.CrAnStates}
    (h : ψ.1 = φ) : {φs : List 𝓕.States} → (ψs : CrAnSection φs) →
    Wick.koszulSignInsert 𝓕.crAnStatistics 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel ψ ψs.1 =
    Wick.koszulSignInsert 𝓕.statesStatistic 𝓕.timeOrderRel φ φs
  | [], ⟨[], h⟩ => by
    simp [Wick.koszulSignInsert]
  | φ' :: φs, ⟨ψ' :: ψs, h1⟩ => by
    simp only [Wick.koszulSignInsert, crAnTimeOrderRel, h]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at h1
    have hi

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnTimeOrderSign_crAnSection
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma crAnTimeOrderSign_crAnSection : {φs : List 𝓕.States} → (ψs : CrAnSection φs) →
    crAnTimeOrderSign ψs.1 = timeOrderSign φs
  | [], ⟨[], h⟩ => by
    simp
  | φ :: φs, ⟨ψ :: ψs, h⟩ => by
    simp only [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign, timeOrderSign]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at h
    congr 1
    · rw [koszulSignInsert_crAnTimeOrderRel_crAnSection h.1 ⟨ψs, h.2⟩]
    · exact crAnTimeOrderSign_crAnSection ⟨ψs, h.2⟩

entries.name: FieldSpecification.orderedInsert_crAnTimeOrderRel_crAnSection
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsert_crAnTimeOrderRel_crAnSection {φ : 𝓕.States} {ψ : 𝓕.CrAnStates}
    (h : ψ.1 = φ) : {φs : List 𝓕.States} → (ψs : CrAnSection φs) →
    (List.orderedInsert 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel ψ ψs.1).map 𝓕.crAnStatesToStates =
    List.orderedInsert 𝓕.timeOrderRel φ φs
  | [], ⟨[], _⟩ => by
    simp only [List.orderedInsert, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.cons.injEq, and_true]
    exact h
  | φ' :: φs, ⟨ψ' :: ψs, h1⟩ => by
    simp only [List.orderedInsert, crAnTimeOrderRel, h]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at h1
    by_cases hr : timeOrderRel φ φ'
    · simp only [hr, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [← h1.1] at hr
      simp only [crAnStatesToStates] at hr
      simp only [hr, ↓reduceIte, List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq]
      exact And.intro h (And.intro h1.1 h1.2)
    · simp only [hr, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [← h1.1] at hr
      simp only [crAnStatesToStates] at hr
      simp only [hr, ↓reduceIte, List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq]
      apply And.intro h1.1
      exact orderedInsert_crAnTimeOrderRel_crAnSection h ⟨ψs, h1.2⟩

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnTimeOrderList_crAnSection_is_crAnSection
entries.snippet:
lemma crAnTimeOrderList_crAnSection_is_crAnSection : {φs : List 𝓕.States} → (ψs : CrAnSection φs) →
    (crAnTimeOrderList ψs.1).map 𝓕.crAnStatesToStates = timeOrderList φs
  | [], ⟨[], h⟩ => by
    simp
  | φ :: φs, ⟨ψ :: ψs, h⟩ => by
    simp only [crAnTimeOrderList, List.insertionSort, timeOrderList]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at h
    exact orderedInsert_crAnTimeOrderRel_crAnSection h.1 ⟨(List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel ψs),
      crAnTimeOrderList_crAnSection_is_crAnSection ⟨ψs, h.2⟩⟩

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnSectionTimeOrder
entries.docstring: Time ordering of sections of a list of states.
entries.snippet:
def crAnSectionTimeOrder (φs : List 𝓕.States) (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    CrAnSection (timeOrderList φs)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.orderedInsert_crAnTimeOrderRel_injective
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsert_crAnTimeOrderRel_injective {ψ ψ' : 𝓕.CrAnStates} (h : ψ.1 = ψ'.1) :
    {φs : List 𝓕.States} → (ψs ψs' : 𝓕.CrAnSection φs) →
    (ho : List.orderedInsert crAnTimeOrderRel ψ ψs.1 =
    List.orderedInsert crAnTimeOrderRel ψ' ψs'.1) → ψ = ψ' ∧ ψs = ψs'
  | [], ⟨[], _⟩, ⟨[], _⟩, h => by
    simp only [List.orderedInsert, List.cons.injEq, and_true] at h
    simpa using h
  | φ :: φs, ⟨ψ1 :: ψs, h1⟩, ⟨ψ1' :: ψs', h1'⟩, ho => by
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at h1 h1'
    have ih

entries.name: FieldSpecification.crAnSectionTimeOrder_injective
entries.snippet:
lemma crAnSectionTimeOrder_injective : {φs : List 𝓕.States} →
    Function.Injective (𝓕.crAnSectionTimeOrder φs)
  | [], ⟨[], _⟩, ⟨[], _⟩ => by
    simp
  | φ :: φs, ⟨ψ :: ψs, h⟩, ⟨ψ' :: ψs', h'⟩ => by
    intro h1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [List.cons.injEq]
    simp only [crAnSectionTimeOrder] at h1
    rw [Subtype.eq_iff] at h1
    simp only [crAnTimeOrderList, List.insertionSort] at h1
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at h h'
    rw [crAnStatesToStates] at h h'
    have hin

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofList_cons_eq_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_cons_eq_mul (s : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (φ : 𝓕) (φs : List 𝓕) :
    ofList s (φ :: φs) = s φ * ofList s φs

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofList_eq_prod
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_eq_prod (s : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) : (φs : List 𝓕) →
    ofList s φs = (List.map s φs).prod
  | [] => rfl
  | φ :: φs => by
    rw [ofList_cons_eq_mul, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, ofList_eq_prod]

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofList_append_eq_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_append_eq_mul (s : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (φs φs' : List 𝓕) :
    ofList s (φs ++ φs') = ofList s φs * ofList s φs'

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofList_map_eq_finset_prod
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_map_eq_finset_prod (s : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) :
    (φs : List 𝓕) → (l : List (Fin φs.length)) → (hl : l.Nodup) →
    ofList s (l.map φs.get) = ∏ (i : Fin φs.length), if i ∈ l then s φs[i] else 1
  | [], [], _ => rfl
  | [], i :: l, hl => Fin.elim0 i
  | φ :: φs, [], hl => by
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.map_nil, ofList_empty, List.not_mem_nil, ↓reduceIte,
      Finset.prod_const_one]
    rfl
  | φ :: φs, i :: l, hl => by
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.map_cons, List.get_eq_getElem, List.mem_cons, instCommGroup,
      Fin.getElem_fin]
    rw [ofList_cons_eq_mul]
    rw [ofList_map_eq_finset_prod s (φ :: φs) l]
    have h1 : s (φ :: φs)[↑i] = ∏ (j : Fin (φ :: φs).length),
      if j = i then s (φ :: φs)[↑i] else 1

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofList_pair
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_pair (s : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (φ1 φ2 : 𝓕) :
    ofList s [φ1, φ2] = s φ1 * s φ2

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofList_take_insert
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_take_insert (n : ℕ) (φ : 𝓕) (φs : List 𝓕) :
    ofList q (List.take n φs) = ofList q (List.take n (List.insertIdx n φ φs))

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofList_take_eraseIdx
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_take_eraseIdx (n : ℕ) (φs : List 𝓕) :
    ofList q (List.take n (φs.eraseIdx n)) = ofList q (List.take n φs)

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofList_take_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_take_zero (φs : List 𝓕) :
    ofList q (List.take 0 φs) = 1

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofList_take_succ_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_take_succ_cons (n : ℕ) (φ1 : 𝓕) (φs : List 𝓕) :
    ofList q ((φ1 :: φs).take (n + 1)) = q φ1 * ofList q (φs.take n)

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofList_take_insertIdx_gt
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_take_insertIdx_gt (n m : ℕ) (φ1 : 𝓕) (φs : List 𝓕) (hn : n < m) :
    ofList q ((List.insertIdx m φ1 φs).take n) = ofList q (φs.take n)

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofList_insert_lt_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_insert_lt_eq (n m : ℕ) (φ1 : 𝓕) (φs : List 𝓕) (hn : m ≤ n)
    (hm : m ≤ φs.length) :
    ofList q ((List.insertIdx m φ1 φs).take (n + 1)) =
    ofList q ((φ1 :: φs).take (n + 1))

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofList_take_insertIdx_le
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_take_insertIdx_le (n m : ℕ) (φ1 : 𝓕) (φs : List 𝓕) (hn : m ≤ n) (hm : m ≤ φs.length) :
    ofList q ((List.insertIdx m φ1 φs).take (n + 1)) = q φ1 * ofList q (φs.take n)
