entries.name: FieldStatistic.exchangeSign
entries.docstring:
The exchange sign of two field statistics is defined to be
  `-1` if both field statistics are `fermionic` and `1` otherwise.
  It is a group homomorphism from `FieldStatistic` to the group of homomorphisms from
  `FieldStatistic` to `ℂ`.
entries.snippet: def exchangeSign : FieldStatistic →* FieldStatistic →* ℂ where

entries.name: FieldStatistic.exchangeSign_symm
entries.docstring: The exchange sign is symmetric.
entries.snippet: lemma exchangeSign_symm (a b : FieldStatistic) : 𝓢(a, b) = 𝓢(b, a)

entries.name: FieldStatistic.exchangeSign_bosonic
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma exchangeSign_bosonic (a : FieldStatistic) : 𝓢(a, bosonic) = 1

entries.name: FieldStatistic.bosonic_exchangeSign
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma bosonic_exchangeSign (a : FieldStatistic) : 𝓢(bosonic, a) = 1

entries.name: FieldStatistic.fermionic_exchangeSign_fermionic
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fermionic_exchangeSign_fermionic : 𝓢(fermionic, fermionic) = - 1

entries.name: FieldStatistic.exchangeSign_eq_if
entries.snippet:
lemma exchangeSign_eq_if (a b : FieldStatistic) :
    𝓢(a, b) = if a = fermionic ∧ b = fermionic then - 1 else 1

entries.name: FieldStatistic.exchangeSign_mul_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma exchangeSign_mul_self (a b : FieldStatistic) : 𝓢(a, b) * 𝓢(a, b) = 1

entries.name: FieldStatistic.exchangeSign_mul_self_swap
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma exchangeSign_mul_self_swap (a b : FieldStatistic) : 𝓢(a, b) * 𝓢(b, a) = 1

entries.name: FieldStatistic.exchangeSign_ofList_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma exchangeSign_ofList_cons (a : FieldStatistic)
    (s : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (φ : 𝓕) (φs : List 𝓕) :
    𝓢(a, ofList s (φ :: φs)) = 𝓢(a, s φ) * 𝓢(a, ofList s φs)

entries.name: FieldStatistic.exchangeSign_cocycle
entries.docstring: The exchange sign is a cocycle.
entries.snippet:
lemma exchangeSign_cocycle (a b c : FieldStatistic) :
    𝓢(a, b * c) * 𝓢(b, c) = 𝓢(a, b) * 𝓢(a * b, c)

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofFinset
entries.docstring:
The field statistic associated with a map `f : Fin n → 𝓕` (usually `.get` of a list)
  and a finite set of elements of `Fin n`.
entries.snippet:
def ofFinset {n : ℕ} (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (f : Fin n → 𝓕) (a : Finset (Fin n)) :
    FieldStatistic

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofFinset_empty
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofFinset_empty (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (f : Fin n → 𝓕) :
    ofFinset q f ∅ = 1

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofFinset_singleton
entries.snippet:
lemma ofFinset_singleton {n : ℕ} (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (f : Fin n → 𝓕) (i : Fin n) :
    ofFinset q f {i} = q (f i)

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofFinset_finset_map
entries.snippet:
lemma ofFinset_finset_map {n m : ℕ}
    (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (i : Fin m → Fin n) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (f : Fin n → 𝓕) (a : Finset (Fin m)) :
    ofFinset q (f ∘ i) a = ofFinset q f (a.map ⟨i, hi⟩)

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofFinset_insert
entries.snippet:
lemma ofFinset_insert (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (φs : List 𝓕) (a : Finset (Fin φs.length))
    (i : Fin φs.length) (h : i ∉ a) :
    ofFinset q φs.get (Insert.insert i a) = (q φs[i]) * ofFinset q φs.get a

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofFinset_erase
entries.snippet:
lemma ofFinset_erase (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (φs : List 𝓕) (a : Finset (Fin φs.length))
    (i : Fin φs.length) (h : i ∈ a) :
    ofFinset q φs.get (a.erase i) = (q φs[i]) * ofFinset q φs.get a

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofFinset_eq_prod
entries.snippet:
lemma ofFinset_eq_prod (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (φs : List 𝓕) (a : Finset (Fin φs.length)) :
    ofFinset q φs.get a = ∏ (i : Fin φs.length), if i ∈ a then (q φs[i]) else 1

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofFinset_union
entries.snippet:
lemma ofFinset_union (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (φs : List 𝓕) (a b : Finset (Fin φs.length)) :
    ofFinset q φs.get a * ofFinset q φs.get b = ofFinset q φs.get ((a ∪ b) \ (a ∩ b))

entries.name: FieldStatistic.ofFinset_union_disjoint
entries.snippet:
lemma ofFinset_union_disjoint (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (φs : List 𝓕) (a b : Finset (Fin φs.length))
    (h : Disjoint a b) :
    ofFinset q φs.get a * ofFinset q φs.get b = ofFinset q φs.get (a ∪ b)

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_singleton
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma koszulSign_singleton (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (le : 𝓕 → 𝓕 → Prop) [DecidableRel le] (φ : 𝓕) :
    koszulSign q le [φ] = 1

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_eraseIdx
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSign_eraseIdx [IsTotal 𝓕 le] [IsTrans 𝓕 le] (φs : List 𝓕) (n : Fin φs.length) :
    koszulSign q le (φs.eraseIdx n) = koszulSign q le φs * 𝓢(q (φs.get n), ofList q (φs.take n)) *
    𝓢(q (φs.get n), ofList q (List.take (↑(insertionSortEquiv le φs n))
    (List.insertionSort le φs)))

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_eraseIdx_insertionSortMinPos
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSign_eraseIdx_insertionSortMinPos [IsTotal 𝓕 le] [IsTrans 𝓕 le] (φ : 𝓕) (φs : List 𝓕) :
    koszulSign q le ((φ :: φs).eraseIdx (insertionSortMinPos le φ φs)) = koszulSign q le (φ :: φs)
    * 𝓢(q (insertionSortMin le φ φs), ofList q ((φ :: φs).take (insertionSortMinPos le φ φs)))

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_swap_eq_rel_cons
Wick.koszulSign_swap_eq_rel
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSign_swap_eq_rel {ψ φ : 𝓕} (h1 : le φ ψ) (h2 : le ψ φ) : (φs φs' : List 𝓕) →
    koszulSign q le (φs ++ φ :: ψ :: φs') = koszulSign q le (φs ++ ψ :: φ :: φs')
  | [], φs' => by
    simp only [List.nil_append]
    exact koszulSign_swap_eq_rel_cons q le h1 h2 φs'
  | φ'' :: φs, φs' => by
    simp only [Wick.koszulSign, List.append_eq]
    rw [koszulSign_swap_eq_rel h1 h2]
    congr 1
    apply Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_perm
    exact List.Perm.append_left φs (List.Perm.swap ψ φ φs')

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat_append
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat_append {ψ φ : 𝓕} [IsTrans 𝓕 le]
    (h1 : le φ ψ) (h2 : le ψ φ) (hq : q ψ = q φ) : (φs : List 𝓕) →
    koszulSign q le (φ :: ψ :: φs) = koszulSign q le φs

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat {ψ φ : 𝓕} [IsTrans 𝓕 le]
    (h1 : le φ ψ) (h2 : le ψ φ) (hq : q ψ = q φ) : (φs' φs : List 𝓕) →
    koszulSign q le (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) = koszulSign q le (φs' ++ φs)
  | [], φs => by
    simp only [List.nil_append]
    exact koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat_append q le h1 h2 hq φs
  | φ'' :: φs', φs => by
    simp only [koszulSign, List.append_eq]
    rw [koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat h1 h2 hq φs' φs]
    simp only [mul_eq_mul_right_iff]
    left
    trans koszulSignInsert q le φ'' (φ :: ψ :: (φs' ++ φs))
    apply koszulSignInsert_eq_perm
    refine List.Perm.symm (List.perm_cons_append_cons φ ?_)
    exact List.Perm.symm List.perm_middle
    rw [koszulSignInsert_eq_remove_same_stat_append q le]
    exact h1
    exact h2
    exact hq

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_of_sorted
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSign_of_sorted : (φs : List 𝓕)
    → (hs : List.Sorted le φs) → koszulSign q le φs = 1
  | [], _ => by
    simp [koszulSign]
  | φ :: φs, h => by
    simp only [koszulSign]
    simp only [List.sorted_cons] at h
    rw [koszulSign_of_sorted φs h.2]
    simp only [mul_one]
    exact koszulSignInsert_of_le_mem _ _ _ _ h.1

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_of_insertionSort
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma koszulSign_of_insertionSort [IsTotal 𝓕 le] [IsTrans 𝓕 le] (φs : List 𝓕) :
    koszulSign q le (List.insertionSort le φs) = 1

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_of_append_eq_insertionSort_left
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSign_of_append_eq_insertionSort_left [IsTotal 𝓕 le] [IsTrans 𝓕 le] :
    (φs φs' : List 𝓕) → koszulSign q le (φs ++ φs') =
    koszulSign q le (List.insertionSort le φs ++ φs') * koszulSign q le φs
  | φs, [] => by
    simp
  | φs, φ :: φs' => by
    have h1 : (φs ++ φ :: φs') = List.insertIdx φs.length φ (φs ++ φs')

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_of_append_eq_insertionSort
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSign_of_append_eq_insertionSort [IsTotal 𝓕 le] [IsTrans 𝓕 le] : (φs'' φs φs' : List 𝓕) →
    koszulSign q le (φs'' ++ φs ++ φs') =
    koszulSign q le (φs'' ++ List.insertionSort le φs ++ φs') * koszulSign q le φs
  | [], φs, φs'=> by
    simp only [List.nil_append]
    exact koszulSign_of_append_eq_insertionSort_left q le φs φs'
  | φ'' :: φs'', φs, φs' => by
    simp only [koszulSign, List.append_eq]
    rw [koszulSign_of_append_eq_insertionSort φs'' φs φs', ← mul_assoc]
    congr 2
    apply koszulSignInsert_eq_perm
    refine (List.perm_append_right_iff φs').mpr ?_
    refine List.Perm.append_left φs'' ?_
    exact List.Perm.symm (List.perm_insertionSort le φs)

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_perm_eq_append
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSign_perm_eq_append [IsTrans 𝓕 le] (φ : 𝓕) (φs φs' φs2 : List 𝓕)
    (hp : φs.Perm φs') : (h : ∀ φ' ∈ φs, le φ φ' ∧ le φ' φ) →
    koszulSign q le (φs ++ φs2) = koszulSign q le (φs' ++ φs2)

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_perm_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSign_perm_eq [IsTrans 𝓕 le] (φ : 𝓕) : (φs1 φs φs' φs2 : List 𝓕) →
    (h : ∀ φ' ∈ φs, le φ φ' ∧ le φ' φ) → (hp : φs.Perm φs') →
    koszulSign q le (φs1 ++ φs ++ φs2) = koszulSign q le (φs1 ++ φs' ++ φs2)
  | [], φs, φs', φs2, h, hp => by
    simp only [List.nil_append]
    exact koszulSign_perm_eq_append q le φ φs φs' φs2 hp h
  | φ1 :: φs1, φs, φs', φs2, h, hp => by
    simp only [koszulSign, List.append_eq]
    have ih

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_exchangeSign_take
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_eq_exchangeSign_take [IsTotal 𝓕 le] [IsTrans 𝓕 le] (φ : 𝓕) (φs : List 𝓕) :
    koszulSignInsert q le φ φs = 𝓢(q φ, ofList q
    ((List.insertionSort le φs).take (orderedInsertPos le (List.insertionSort le φs) φ)))

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignCons_eq_exchangeSign
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignCons_eq_exchangeSign (φ0 φ1 : 𝓕) : koszulSignCons q le φ0 φ1 =
    if le φ0 φ1 then 1 else 𝓢(q φ0, q φ1)

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_of_le_mem
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_of_le_mem (φ0 : 𝓕) : (φs : List 𝓕) → (h : ∀ b ∈ φs, le φ0 b) →
    koszulSignInsert q le φ0 φs = 1
  | [], _ => by
    simp [koszulSignInsert]
  | φ1 :: φs, h => by
    simp only [koszulSignInsert]
    rw [if_pos]
    · apply koszulSignInsert_of_le_mem
      · intro b hb
        exact h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
    · exact h φ1 (List.mem_cons_self _ _)

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_rel_eq_stat
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_eq_rel_eq_stat {ψ φ : 𝓕} [IsTrans 𝓕 le]
    (h1 : le φ ψ) (h2 : le ψ φ) (hq : q ψ = q φ) : (φs : List 𝓕) →
    koszulSignInsert q le φ φs = koszulSignInsert q le ψ φs
  | [] => by
    simp [koszulSignInsert]
  | φ' :: φs => by
    simp only [koszulSignInsert]
    simp_all only
    by_cases hr : le φ φ'
    · simp only [hr, ↓reduceIte]
      have h1' : le ψ φ'

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_remove_same_stat_append
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_eq_remove_same_stat_append {ψ φ φ' : 𝓕} [IsTrans 𝓕 le]
    (h1 : le φ ψ) (h2 : le ψ φ) (hq : q ψ = q φ) : (φs : List 𝓕) →
    koszulSignInsert q le φ' (φ :: ψ :: φs) = koszulSignInsert q le φ' φs

entries.name: WickContraction
entries.docstring:
Given a natural number `n` corresponding to the number of fields, a Wick contraction
is a finite set of pairs of `Fin n`, such that no element of `Fin n` occurs in more then one pair.
For example for `n = 3` there are `4` Wick contractions:
- `∅`, corresponding to the case where no fields are contracted.
- `{{0, 1}}`, corresponding to the case where the field at position `0` and `1` are contracted.
- `{{0, 2}}`, corresponding to the case where the field at position `0` and `2` are contracted.
- `{{1, 2}}`, corresponding to the case where the field at position `1` and `2` are contracted.
For `n=4` some possible Wick contractions are
- `∅`, corresponding to the case where no fields are contracted.
- `{{0, 1}, {2, 3}}`, corresponding to the case where the field at position `0` and `1` are
  contracted and the field at position `2` and `3` are contracted.
- `{{0, 2}, {1, 3}}`, corresponding to the case where the field at position `0` and `2` are
  contracted and the field at position `1` and `3` are contracted.
  etc.
entries.snippet: def WickContraction (n : ℕ) : Type

entries.name: WickContraction.empty
entries.docstring: The contraction consisting of no contracted pairs.
entries.snippet: def empty : WickContraction n

entries.name: WickContraction.congr
entries.docstring:
The equivalence between `WickContraction n` and `WickContraction m`
  derived from a propositional equality of `n` and `m`.
entries.snippet:
def congr : {n m : ℕ} → (h : n = m) → WickContraction n ≃ WickContraction m
  | n, .(n), rfl => Equiv.refl _

entries.name: WickContraction.congr_refl
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma congr_refl : c.congr rfl = c

entries.name: WickContraction.congr_contractions
entries.snippet:
lemma congr_contractions {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (c : WickContraction n) :
    ((congr h) c).1 = Finset.map (Finset.mapEmbedding (finCongr h)).toEmbedding c.1

entries.name: WickContraction.congr_trans
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma congr_trans {n m o : ℕ} (h1 : n = m) (h2 : m = o) :
    (congr h1).trans (congr h2) = congr (h1.trans h2)

entries.name: WickContraction.congr_trans_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma congr_trans_apply {n m o : ℕ} (h1 : n = m) (h2 : m = o) (c : WickContraction n) :
    (congr h2) ((congr h1) c) = congr (h1.trans h2) c

entries.name: WickContraction.congrLift
entries.docstring:
Given a contracted pair in `c : WickContraction n` the contracted pair
  in `congr h c`.
entries.snippet: def congrLift {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) {c : WickContraction n} (a : c.1) : (congr h c).1

entries.name: WickContraction.congrLift_rfl
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma congrLift_rfl {n : ℕ} {c : WickContraction n} :
    c.congrLift rfl = id

entries.name: WickContraction.congrLift_injective
entries.snippet:
lemma congrLift_injective {n m : ℕ} {c : WickContraction n} (h : n = m) :
    Function.Injective (c.congrLift h)

entries.name: WickContraction.congrLift_surjective
entries.snippet:
lemma congrLift_surjective {n m : ℕ} {c : WickContraction n} (h : n = m) :
    Function.Surjective (c.congrLift h)

entries.name: WickContraction.congrLift_bijective
entries.snippet:
lemma congrLift_bijective {n m : ℕ} {c : WickContraction n} (h : n = m) :
    Function.Bijective (c.congrLift h)

entries.name: WickContraction.eq_filter_mem_self
entries.snippet: lemma eq_filter_mem_self : c.1 = Finset.filter (fun x => x ∈ c.1) Finset.univ

entries.name: WickContraction.getDual?
entries.docstring:
For a contraction `c : WickContraction n` and `i : Fin n` the `j` such that
  `{i, j}` is a contracted pair in `c`. If such an `j` does not exist, this returns `none`.
entries.snippet: def getDual? (i : Fin n) : Option (Fin n)

entries.name: WickContraction.getDual?_congr
entries.snippet:
lemma getDual?_congr {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin m) :
    (congr h c).getDual? i = Option.map (finCongr h) (c.getDual? (finCongr h.symm i))

entries.name: WickContraction.getDual?_congr_get
entries.snippet:
lemma getDual?_congr_get {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin m)
    (hg : ((congr h c).getDual? i).isSome) :
    ((congr h c).getDual? i).get hg =
    (finCongr h ((c.getDual? (finCongr h.symm i)).get (by simpa [getDual?_congr] using hg)))

entries.name: WickContraction.getDual?_eq_some_iff_mem
entries.snippet:
lemma getDual?_eq_some_iff_mem (i j : Fin n) :
    c.getDual? i = some j ↔ {i, j} ∈ c.1

entries.name: WickContraction.getDual?_one_eq_none
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma getDual?_one_eq_none (c : WickContraction 1) (i : Fin 1) : c.getDual? i = none

entries.name: WickContraction.getDual?_get_self_mem
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma getDual?_get_self_mem (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    {(c.getDual? i).get h, i} ∈ c.1

entries.name: WickContraction.self_getDual?_get_mem
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma self_getDual?_get_mem (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    {i, (c.getDual? i).get h} ∈ c.1

entries.name: WickContraction.getDual?_eq_some_neq
entries.snippet:
lemma getDual?_eq_some_neq (i j : Fin n) (h : c.getDual? i = some j) :
    ¬ i = j

entries.name: WickContraction.self_neq_getDual?_get
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma self_neq_getDual?_get (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    ¬ i = (c.getDual? i).get h

entries.name: WickContraction.getDual?_get_self_neq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma getDual?_get_self_neq (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    ¬ (c.getDual? i).get h = i

entries.name: WickContraction.getDual?_isSome_iff
entries.snippet: lemma getDual?_isSome_iff (i : Fin n) : (c.getDual? i).isSome ↔ ∃ (a : c.1), i ∈ a.1

entries.name: WickContraction.getDual?_isSome_of_mem
entries.snippet: lemma getDual?_isSome_of_mem (a : c.1) (i : a.1) : (c.getDual? i).isSome

entries.name: WickContraction.getDual?_getDual?_get_get
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma getDual?_getDual?_get_get (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    c.getDual? ((c.getDual? i).get h) = some i

entries.name: WickContraction.getDual?_getDual?_get_isSome
entries.snippet:
lemma getDual?_getDual?_get_isSome (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    (c.getDual? ((c.getDual? i).get h)).isSome

entries.name: WickContraction.getDual?_getDual?_get_not_none
entries.snippet:
lemma getDual?_getDual?_get_not_none (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    ¬ (c.getDual? ((c.getDual? i).get h)) = none

entries.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract
entries.docstring: The smallest of the two positions in a contracted pair given a Wick contraction.
entries.snippet: def fstFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) : Fin n

entries.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_congr
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fstFieldOfContract_congr {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    (congr h c).fstFieldOfContract (c.congrLift h a) = (finCongr h) (c.fstFieldOfContract a)

entries.name: WickContraction.sndFieldOfContract
entries.docstring: The largest of the two positions in a contracted pair given a Wick contraction.
entries.snippet: def sndFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) : Fin n

entries.name: WickContraction.sndFieldOfContract_congr
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma sndFieldOfContract_congr {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    (congr h c).sndFieldOfContract (c.congrLift h a) = (finCongr h) (c.sndFieldOfContract a)

entries.name: WickContraction.finset_eq_fstFieldOfContract_sndFieldOfContract
entries.snippet:
lemma finset_eq_fstFieldOfContract_sndFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    a.1 = {c.fstFieldOfContract a, c.sndFieldOfContract a}

entries.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_neq_sndFieldOfContract
entries.snippet:
lemma fstFieldOfContract_neq_sndFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.fstFieldOfContract a ≠ c.sndFieldOfContract a

entries.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_le_sndFieldOfContract
entries.snippet:
lemma fstFieldOfContract_le_sndFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.fstFieldOfContract a ≤ c.sndFieldOfContract a

entries.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_lt_sndFieldOfContract
entries.snippet:
lemma fstFieldOfContract_lt_sndFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.fstFieldOfContract a < c.sndFieldOfContract a

entries.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_mem
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fstFieldOfContract_mem (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.fstFieldOfContract a ∈ a.1

entries.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_getDual?_isSome
entries.snippet:
lemma fstFieldOfContract_getDual?_isSome (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    (c.getDual? (c.fstFieldOfContract a)).isSome

entries.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_getDual?
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fstFieldOfContract_getDual? (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.getDual? (c.fstFieldOfContract a) = some (c.sndFieldOfContract a)

entries.name: WickContraction.sndFieldOfContract_mem
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma sndFieldOfContract_mem (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.sndFieldOfContract a ∈ a.1

entries.name: WickContraction.sndFieldOfContract_getDual?_isSome
entries.snippet:
lemma sndFieldOfContract_getDual?_isSome (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    (c.getDual? (c.sndFieldOfContract a)).isSome

entries.name: WickContraction.sndFieldOfContract_getDual?
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma sndFieldOfContract_getDual? (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.getDual? (c.sndFieldOfContract a) = some (c.fstFieldOfContract a)

entries.name: WickContraction.eq_fstFieldOfContract_of_mem
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_fstFieldOfContract_of_mem (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) (i j : Fin n)
    (hi : i ∈ a.1) (hj : j ∈ a.1) (hij : i < j) :
    c.fstFieldOfContract a = i

entries.name: WickContraction.eq_sndFieldOfContract_of_mem
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_sndFieldOfContract_of_mem (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) (i j : Fin n)
    (hi : i ∈ a.1) (hj : j ∈ a.1) (hij : i < j) :
    c.sndFieldOfContract a = j

entries.name: WickContraction.contractEquivFinTwo
entries.docstring:
As a type, any pair of contractions is equivalent to `Fin 2`
  with `0` being associated with `c.fstFieldOfContract a` and `1` being associated with
  `c.sndFieldOfContract`.
entries.snippet:
def contractEquivFinTwo (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    a ≃ Fin 2 where

entries.name: WickContraction.prod_finset_eq_mul_fst_snd
entries.snippet:
lemma prod_finset_eq_mul_fst_snd (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1)
    (f : a.1 → M) [CommMonoid M] :
    ∏ (x : a), f x = f (⟨c.fstFieldOfContract a, fstFieldOfContract_mem c a⟩)
    * f (⟨c.sndFieldOfContract a, sndFieldOfContract_mem c a⟩)

entries.name: WickContraction.GradingCompliant
entries.docstring:
A Wick contraction associated with a list of states is said to be `GradingCompliant` if in any
  contracted pair of states they are either both fermionic or both bosonic.
entries.snippet: def GradingCompliant (φs : List 𝓕.States) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)

entries.name: WickContraction.sigmaContractedEquiv
entries.docstring:
An equivalence from the sigma type `(a : c.1) × a` to the subtype of `Fin n` consisting of
  those positions which are contracted.
entries.snippet: def sigmaContractedEquiv : (a : c.1) × a ≃ {x : Fin n // (c.getDual? x).isSome} where

entries.name: WickContraction.erase
entries.docstring:
Given a Wick contraction `WickContraction n.succ` and a `i : Fin n.succ` the
  Wick contraction associated with `n` obtained by removing `i`.
  If `i` is contracted with `j` in the new Wick contraction `j` will be uncontracted.
entries.snippet: def erase (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ) : WickContraction n

entries.name: WickContraction.mem_erase_uncontracted_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_erase_uncontracted_iff (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ) (j : Fin n) :
    j ∈ (c.erase i).uncontracted ↔
    i.succAbove j ∈ c.uncontracted ∨ c.getDual? (i.succAbove j) = some i

entries.name: WickContraction.mem_not_eq_erase_of_isSome
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_not_eq_erase_of_isSome (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) (ha : a ∈ c.1) (ha2 : a ≠ {i, (c.getDual? i).get h}) :
    ∃ a', a' ∈ (c.erase i).1 ∧ a = Finset.map i.succAboveEmb a'

entries.name: WickContraction.mem_not_eq_erase_of_isNone
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_not_eq_erase_of_isNone (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (h : (c.getDual? i).isNone) (ha : a ∈ c.1) :
    ∃ a', a' ∈ (c.erase i).1 ∧ a = Finset.map i.succAboveEmb a'

entries.name: WickContraction.getDualErase
entries.docstring:
Given a Wick contraction `c : WickContraction n.succ` and a `i : Fin n.succ` the (optional)
  element of `(erase c i).uncontracted` which comes from the element in `c` contracted
  with `i`.
entries.snippet:
def getDualErase {n : ℕ} (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    Option ((erase c i).uncontracted)

entries.name: WickContraction.getDualErase_isSome_iff_getDual?_isSome
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma getDualErase_isSome_iff_getDual?_isSome (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (c.getDualErase i).isSome ↔ (c.getDual? i).isSome

entries.name: WickContraction.getDualErase_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma getDualErase_one (c : WickContraction 1) (i : Fin 1) :
    c.getDualErase i = none

entries.name: WickContraction.extractEquiv_equiv
entries.snippet:
lemma extractEquiv_equiv {c1 c2 : (c : WickContraction n) × Option c.uncontracted}
    (h : c1.1 = c2.1) (ho : c1.2 = uncontractedCongr (by rw [h]) c2.2) : c1 = c2

entries.name: WickContraction.extractEquiv
entries.docstring:
The equivalence between `WickContraction n.succ` and the sigma type
  `(c : WickContraction n) × Option c.uncontracted` formed by inserting
  and erasing elements from a contraction.
entries.snippet:
def extractEquiv (i : Fin n.succ) : WickContraction n.succ ≃
    (c : WickContraction n) × Option c.uncontracted where

entries.name: WickContraction.extractEquiv_symm_none_uncontracted
entries.snippet:
lemma extractEquiv_symm_none_uncontracted (i : Fin n.succ) (c : WickContraction n) :
    ((extractEquiv i).symm ⟨c, none⟩).uncontracted =
    (Insert.insert i (c.uncontracted.map i.succAboveEmb))

entries.name: WickContraction.extractEquiv_apply_congr_symm_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma extractEquiv_apply_congr_symm_apply {n m : ℕ} (k : ℕ)
    (hnk : k < n.succ) (hkm : k < m.succ) (hnm : n = m) (c : WickContraction n)
    (i : c.uncontracted) : congr (by rw [hnm]) ((extractEquiv ⟨k, hkm⟩
    (congr (by rw [hnm]) ((extractEquiv ⟨k, hnk⟩).symm ⟨c, i⟩)))).1 = c

entries.name: WickContraction.fintype_zero
entries.docstring:
The fintype instance of `WickContraction 0` defined through its single
  element `empty`.
entries.snippet: instance fintype_zero : Fintype (WickContraction 0) where

entries.name: WickContraction.sum_WickContraction_nil
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_WickContraction_nil (f : WickContraction 0 → M) [AddCommMonoid M] :
    ∑ c, f c = f empty

entries.name: WickContraction.fintype_succ
entries.docstring:
The fintype instance of `WickContraction n`, for `n.succ` this is defined
  through the equivalence `extractEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
instance fintype_succ : (n : ℕ) → Fintype (WickContraction n)
  | 0 => fintype_zero
  | Nat.succ n => by
    letI

entries.name: WickContraction.sum_extractEquiv_congr
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_extractEquiv_congr [AddCommMonoid M] {n m : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (f : WickContraction n → M)
    (h : n = m.succ) :
    ∑ c, f c = ∑ (c : WickContraction m), ∑ (k : Option c.uncontracted),
    f (congr h.symm ((extractEquiv (finCongr h i)).symm ⟨c, k⟩))

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract
entries.docstring:
Given a Wick contraction `c` associated to a list `φs`,
  a position `i : Fin n.succ`, an element `φ`, and an optional uncontracted element
  `j : Option (c.uncontracted)` of `c`.
  The Wick contraction associated with `(φs.insertIdx i φ).length` formed by 'inserting' `φ`
  into `φs` after the first `i` elements and contracting it optionally with j.

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_fstFieldOfContract
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContract_fstFieldOfContract (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Option φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (a : φsΛ.1) : (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i j).fstFieldOfContract
    (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (insertLift i j a)) =
    finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove (φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract a))

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_sndFieldOfContract
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContract_sndFieldOfContract (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Option (φsΛ.uncontracted))
    (a : φsΛ.1) : (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i j).sndFieldOfContract
    (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (insertLift i j a)) =
    finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove (φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a))

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_fstFieldOfContract_some_incl
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContract_fstFieldOfContract_some_incl (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
      (insertAndContract φ φsΛ i (some j)).fstFieldOfContract
      (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm ⟨{i, i.succAbove j}, by
        simp [insertAndContractNat]⟩) =
      if i < i.succAbove j.1 then
      finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i else
      finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j.1)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_none_getDual?_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContract_none_getDual?_self (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i) = none

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_isSome_getDual?_self
entries.snippet:
lemma insertAndContract_isSome_getDual?_self (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).getDual?
    (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)).isSome

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_some_getDual?_self_not_none
entries.snippet:
lemma insertAndContract_some_getDual?_self_not_none (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    ¬ ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).getDual?
    (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)) = none

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_some_getDual?_self_eq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContract_some_getDual?_self_eq (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i))
    = some (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j))

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_some_getDual?_some_eq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContract_some_getDual?_some_eq (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).getDual?
      (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j)))
    = some (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_none_succAbove_getDual?_eq_none_iff
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContract_none_succAbove_getDual?_eq_none_iff (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Fin φs.length) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
      (i.succAbove j)) = none ↔ φsΛ.getDual? j = none

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_some_succAbove_getDual?_eq_option
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContract_some_succAbove_getDual?_eq_option (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Fin φs.length)
    (k : φsΛ.uncontracted) (hkj : j ≠ k.1) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
    (i.succAbove j)) = Option.map (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm ∘ i.succAbove)
    (φsΛ.getDual? j)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_none_succAbove_getDual?_isSome_iff
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContract_none_succAbove_getDual?_isSome_iff (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Fin φs.length) :
    ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
      (i.succAbove j))).isSome ↔ (φsΛ.getDual? j).isSome

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_none_getDual?_get_eq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContract_none_getDual?_get_eq (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Fin φs.length)
    (h : ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
    (i.succAbove j))).isSome) :
    ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
    (i.succAbove j))).get h = Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
    (i.succAbove ((φsΛ.getDual? j).get (by simpa using h)))

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_sndFieldOfContract_some_incl
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContract_sndFieldOfContract_some_incl (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).sndFieldOfContract
    (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm ⟨{i, i.succAbove j}, by
      simp [insertAndContractNat]⟩) =
    if i < i.succAbove j.1 then
    finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j.1) else
    finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_none_prod_contractions
entries.snippet:
lemma insertAndContract_none_prod_contractions (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ)
    (f : (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).1 → M) [CommMonoid M] :
    ∏ a, f a = ∏ (a : φsΛ.1), f (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
      (insertLift i none a))

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_some_prod_contractions
entries.snippet:
lemma insertAndContract_some_prod_contractions (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (f : (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).1 → M) [CommMonoid M] :
    ∏ a, f a = f (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
      ⟨{i, i.succAbove j}, by simp [insertAndContractNat]⟩) *
    ∏ (a : φsΛ.1), f (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (insertLift i (some j) a))

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractLiftFinset
entries.docstring:
Given a finite set of `Fin φs.length` the finite set of `(φs.insertIdx i φ).length`
  formed by mapping elements using `i.succAboveEmb` and `finCongr`.

entries.name: WickContraction.self_not_mem_insertAndContractLiftFinset
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma self_not_mem_insertAndContractLiftFinset (φ : 𝓕.States) {φs : List 𝓕.States}
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (a : Finset (Fin φs.length)) :
    Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i ∉ insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i a

entries.name: WickContraction.succAbove_mem_insertAndContractLiftFinset
entries.snippet:
lemma succAbove_mem_insertAndContractLiftFinset (φ : 𝓕.States) {φs : List 𝓕.States}
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (a : Finset (Fin φs.length)) (j : Fin φs.length) :
    Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j)
    ∈ insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i a ↔ j ∈ a

entries.name: WickContraction.insert_fin_eq_self
entries.snippet:
lemma insert_fin_eq_self (φ : 𝓕.States) {φs : List 𝓕.States}
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Fin (List.insertIdx i φ φs).length) :
    j = Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i
    ∨ ∃ k, j = Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove k)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertLift_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma insertLift_sum (φ : 𝓕.States) {φs : List 𝓕.States}
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) [AddCommMonoid M] (f : WickContraction (φs.insertIdx i φ).length → M) :
    ∑ c, f c =
    ∑ (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length), ∑ (k : Option φsΛ.uncontracted), f (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i k)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_uncontractedList_none_map
WickContraction.insertAndContract_uncontractedList_none_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContract_uncontractedList_none_zero (φ : 𝓕.States) {φs : List 𝓕.States}
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    [φsΛ ↩Λ φ 0 none]ᵘᶜ = φ :: [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat
entries.docstring:
Given a Wick contraction `c` for `n`, a position `i : Fin n.succ` and
  an optional uncontracted element `j : Option (c.uncontracted)` of `c`.
  The Wick contraction for `n.succ` formed by 'inserting' `i` into `Fin n`
  and contracting it optionally with `j`.
entries.snippet:
def insertAndContractNat (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) (j : Option (c.uncontracted)) :
    WickContraction n.succ

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_of_isSome
entries.snippet:
lemma insertAndContractNat_of_isSome (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Option c.uncontracted) (hj : j.isSome) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i j).1 = Insert.insert {i, i.succAbove (j.get hj)}
    (Finset.map (Finset.mapEmbedding i.succAboveEmb).toEmbedding c.1)

entries.name: WickContraction.self_mem_uncontracted_of_insertAndContractNat_none
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma self_mem_uncontracted_of_insertAndContractNat_none (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    i ∈ (insertAndContractNat c i none).uncontracted

entries.name: WickContraction.self_not_mem_uncontracted_of_insertAndContractNat_some
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma self_not_mem_uncontracted_of_insertAndContractNat_some (c : WickContraction n)
    (i : Fin n.succ) (j : c.uncontracted) :
    i ∉ (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).uncontracted

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_succAbove_mem_uncontracted_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma insertAndContractNat_succAbove_mem_uncontracted_iff (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Fin n) :
    (i.succAbove j) ∈ (insertAndContractNat c i none).uncontracted ↔ j ∈ c.uncontracted

entries.name: WickContraction.mem_uncontracted_insertAndContractNat_none_iff
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mem_uncontracted_insertAndContractNat_none_iff (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (k : Fin n.succ) : k ∈ (insertAndContractNat c i none).uncontracted ↔
    k = i ∨ ∃ j, k = i.succAbove j ∧ j ∈ c.uncontracted

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_none_uncontracted
entries.snippet:
lemma insertAndContractNat_none_uncontracted (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i none).uncontracted =
    Insert.insert i (c.uncontracted.map i.succAboveEmb)

entries.name: WickContraction.mem_uncontracted_insertAndContractNat_some_iff
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mem_uncontracted_insertAndContractNat_some_iff (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (k : Fin n.succ) (j : c.uncontracted) :
    k ∈ (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).uncontracted ↔
    ∃ z, k = i.succAbove z ∧ z ∈ c.uncontracted ∧ z ≠ j

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_some_uncontracted
entries.snippet:
lemma insertAndContractNat_some_uncontracted (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : c.uncontracted) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).uncontracted =
    (c.uncontracted.erase j).map i.succAboveEmb

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_none_getDual?_isNone
entries.snippet:
lemma insertAndContractNat_none_getDual?_isNone (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    ((insertAndContractNat c i none).getDual? i).isNone

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_succAbove_getDual?_eq_none_iff
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContractNat_succAbove_getDual?_eq_none_iff (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Fin n) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i none).getDual? (i.succAbove j) = none ↔ c.getDual? j = none

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_succAbove_getDual?_isSome_iff
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContractNat_succAbove_getDual?_isSome_iff (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Fin n) :
    ((insertAndContractNat c i none).getDual? (i.succAbove j)).isSome ↔ (c.getDual? j).isSome

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_succAbove_getDual?_get
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContractNat_succAbove_getDual?_get (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Fin n) (h : ((insertAndContractNat c i none).getDual? (i.succAbove j)).isSome) :
    ((insertAndContractNat c i none).getDual? (i.succAbove j)).get h =
    i.succAbove ((c.getDual? j).get (by simpa using h))

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_eq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_eq (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : c.uncontracted) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual? i = some (i.succAbove j)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_neq_none
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_neq_none (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : c.uncontracted) (k : Fin n) (hkj : k ≠ j.1) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual? (i.succAbove k) = none ↔ c.getDual? k = none

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_neq_isSome
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_neq_isSome (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : c.uncontracted) (k : Fin n) (hkj : k ≠ j.1) :
    ((insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual? (i.succAbove k)).isSome ↔
    (c.getDual? k).isSome

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_neq_isSome_get
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_neq_isSome_get (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : c.uncontracted) (k : Fin n) (hkj : k ≠ j.1)
    (h : ((insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual? (i.succAbove k)).isSome) :
    ((insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual? (i.succAbove k)).get h =
    i.succAbove ((c.getDual? k).get (by simpa [hkj] using h))

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_of_neq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_of_neq (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : c.uncontracted) (k : Fin n) (hkj : k ≠ j.1) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual? (i.succAbove k) =
    Option.map i.succAbove (c.getDual? k)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_erase
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContractNat_erase (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Option c.uncontracted) : erase (insertAndContractNat c i j) i = c

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_getDualErase
entries.snippet:
lemma insertAndContractNat_getDualErase (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Option c.uncontracted) : (insertAndContractNat c i j).getDualErase i =
    uncontractedCongr (c := c) (c' := (c.insertAndContractNat i j).erase i) (by simp) j

entries.name: WickContraction.erase_insert
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma erase_insert (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    insertAndContractNat (erase c i) i (getDualErase c i) = c

entries.name: WickContraction.insertLift
entries.docstring: Lifts a contraction in `c` to a contraction in `(c.insert i j)`.
entries.snippet:
def insertLift {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) (j : Option (c.uncontracted))
    (a : c.1) : (c.insertAndContractNat i j).1

entries.name: WickContraction.insertLift_injective
entries.snippet:
lemma insertLift_injective {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) (j : Option (c.uncontracted)) :
    Function.Injective (insertLift i j)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertLift_none_surjective
entries.snippet:
lemma insertLift_none_surjective {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) :
    Function.Surjective (c.insertLift i none)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertLift_none_bijective
entries.snippet:
lemma insertLift_none_bijective {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) :
    Function.Bijective (c.insertLift i none)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_fstFieldOfContract
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContractNat_fstFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Option (c.uncontracted)) (a : c.1) :
    (c.insertAndContractNat i j).fstFieldOfContract (insertLift i j a) =
      i.succAbove (c.fstFieldOfContract a)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_sndFieldOfContract
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContractNat_sndFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Option (c.uncontracted)) (a : c.1) :
    (c.insertAndContractNat i j).sndFieldOfContract (insertLift i j a) =
    i.succAbove (c.sndFieldOfContract a)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertLiftSome
entries.docstring:
Given a contracted pair for a Wick contraction `WickContraction n`, the
  corresponding contracted pair of a wick contraction `(c.insert i (some j))` formed
  by inserting an element `i` into the contraction.
entries.snippet:
def insertLiftSome {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) (j : c.uncontracted)
    (a : Unit ⊕ c.1) : (c.insertAndContractNat i (some j)).1

entries.name: WickContraction.insertLiftSome_injective
entries.snippet:
lemma insertLiftSome_injective {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) (j : c.uncontracted) :
    Function.Injective (insertLiftSome i j)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertLiftSome_surjective
entries.snippet:
lemma insertLiftSome_surjective {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) (j : c.uncontracted) :
    Function.Surjective (insertLiftSome i j)

entries.name: WickContraction.insertLiftSome_bijective
entries.snippet:
lemma insertLiftSome_bijective {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) (j : c.uncontracted) :
    Function.Bijective (insertLiftSome i j)

entries.name: WickContraction.toInvolution
entries.docstring:
The involution of `Fin n` associated with a Wick contraction `c : WickContraction n` as follows.
  If `i : Fin n` is contracted in `c` then it is taken to its dual, otherwise
  it is taken to itself.
entries.snippet: def toInvolution : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f}

entries.name: WickContraction.fromInvolution
entries.docstring:
The Wick contraction formed by an involution `f` of `Fin n` by taking as the contracted
  sets of the contraction the orbits of `f` of cardinality `2`.
entries.snippet: def fromInvolution (f : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f}) : WickContraction n

entries.name: WickContraction.fromInvolution_getDual?_isSome
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fromInvolution_getDual?_isSome (f : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f})
    (i : Fin n) : ((fromInvolution f).getDual? i).isSome ↔ f.1 i ≠ i

entries.name: WickContraction.fromInvolution_getDual?_eq_some
entries.snippet:
lemma fromInvolution_getDual?_eq_some (f : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f}) (i : Fin n)
    (h : ((fromInvolution f).getDual? i).isSome) :
    ((fromInvolution f).getDual? i) = some (f.1 i)

entries.name: WickContraction.fromInvolution_getDual?_get
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fromInvolution_getDual?_get (f : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f}) (i : Fin n)
    (h : ((fromInvolution f).getDual? i).isSome) :
    ((fromInvolution f).getDual? i).get h = (f.1 i)

entries.name: WickContraction.toInvolution_fromInvolution
entries.snippet: lemma toInvolution_fromInvolution : fromInvolution c.toInvolution = c

entries.name: WickContraction.fromInvolution_toInvolution
entries.snippet:
lemma fromInvolution_toInvolution (f : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f}) :
    (fromInvolution f).toInvolution = f

entries.name: WickContraction.equivInvolution
entries.docstring:
The equivalence btween Wick contractions for `n` and involutions of `Fin n`.
  The involution of `Fin n` associated with a Wick contraction `c : WickContraction n` as follows.
  If `i : Fin n` is contracted in `c` then it is taken to its dual, otherwise
  it is taken to itself.
entries.snippet: def equivInvolution : WickContraction n ≃ {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f} where

entries.name: WickContraction.IsFull
entries.docstring:
A contraction is full if there are no uncontracted fields, i.e. the finite set
  of uncontracted fields is empty.
entries.snippet: def IsFull : Prop

entries.name: WickContraction.«instance@ca40cdba»
entries.docstring: The condition on whether or not a contraction is full is decidable.
entries.snippet: instance : Decidable (IsFull c)

entries.name: WickContraction.isFull_iff_equivInvolution_no_fixed_point
entries.snippet:
lemma isFull_iff_equivInvolution_no_fixed_point :
    IsFull c ↔ ∀ (i : Fin n), (equivInvolution c).1 i ≠ i

entries.name: WickContraction.isFullInvolutionEquiv
entries.docstring: The equivalence between full contractions and fixed-point free involutions.
entries.snippet:
def isFullInvolutionEquiv : {c : WickContraction n // IsFull c} ≃
    {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f ∧ (∀ i, f i ≠ i)} where

entries.name: WickContraction.card_of_isfull_even
entries.docstring: If `n` is even then the number of full contractions is `(n-1)!!`.
entries.snippet:
theorem card_of_isfull_even (he : Even n) :
    Fintype.card {c : WickContraction n // IsFull c} = (n - 1)‼

entries.name: WickContraction.card_of_isfull_odd
entries.docstring:
If `n` is odd then there are no full contractions. This is because
  there will always be at least one element unpaired.
entries.snippet:
theorem card_of_isfull_odd (ho : Odd n) :
    Fintype.card {c : WickContraction n // IsFull c} = 0

entries.name: WickContraction.signFinset
entries.docstring:
Given a Wick contraction `c : WickContraction n` and `i1 i2 : Fin n` the finite set
  of elements of `Fin n` between `i1` and `i2` which are either uncontracted
  or are contracted but are contracted with an element occuring after `i1`.
  One should assume `i1 < i2` otherwise this finite set is empty.
entries.snippet: def signFinset (c : WickContraction n) (i1 i2 : Fin n) : Finset (Fin n)

entries.name: WickContraction.signFinset_insertAndContract_none
entries.snippet:
lemma signFinset_insertAndContract_none (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (i1 i2 : Fin φs.length) :
      (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).signFinset (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
      (i.succAbove i1)) (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove i2)) =
    if i.succAbove i1 < i ∧ i < i.succAbove i2 then
      Insert.insert (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)
      (insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i (φsΛ.signFinset i1 i2))
    else
      (insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i (φsΛ.signFinset i1 i2))

entries.name: WickContraction.stat_ofFinset_of_insertAndContractLiftFinset
entries.snippet:
lemma stat_ofFinset_of_insertAndContractLiftFinset (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (a : Finset (Fin φs.length)) :
    (𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨(φs.insertIdx i φ).get, insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i a⟩) = 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, a⟩

entries.name: WickContraction.stat_ofFinset_eq_one_of_gradingCompliant
entries.snippet:
lemma stat_ofFinset_eq_one_of_gradingCompliant (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (a : Finset (Fin φs.length)) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (hg : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ)
    (hnon : ∀ i, φsΛ.getDual? i = none → i ∉ a)
    (hsom : ∀ i, (h : (φsΛ.getDual? i).isSome) → i ∈ a → (φsΛ.getDual? i).get h ∈ a) :
    (𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, a⟩) = 1

entries.name: WickContraction.signFinset_insertAndContract_some
entries.snippet:
lemma signFinset_insertAndContract_some (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (i1 i2 : Fin φs.length)
    (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).signFinset (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
    (i.succAbove i1)) (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove i2)) =
    if i.succAbove i1 < i ∧ i < i.succAbove i2 ∧ (i1 < j) then
      Insert.insert (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)
      (insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i (φsΛ.signFinset i1 i2))
    else
      if i1 < j ∧ j < i2 ∧ ¬ i.succAbove i1 < i then
        (insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i (φsΛ.signFinset i1 i2)).erase
        (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j))
      else
        (insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i (φsΛ.signFinset i1 i2))

entries.name: WickContraction.sign
entries.docstring:
Given a Wick contraction `c` associated with a list of states `φs`
  the sign associated with `c` is sign corresponding to the number
  of fermionic-fermionic exchanges one must do to put elements in contracted pairs
  of `c` next to each other.
  It is important to note that this sign does not depend on any ordering
  placed on `φs` other then the order of the list itself.
entries.snippet: def sign (φs : List 𝓕.States) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) : ℂ

def signInsertNone (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) : ℂ

entries.name: WickContraction.sign_insert_none
entries.snippet:
lemma sign_insert_none (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).sign = (φsΛ.signInsertNone φ φs i) * φsΛ.sign

entries.name: WickContraction.signInsertNone_eq_mul_fst_snd
entries.snippet:
lemma signInsertNone_eq_mul_fst_snd (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) :
  φsΛ.signInsertNone φ φs i = ∏ (a : φsΛ.1),
    (if i.succAbove (φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract a) < i then
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a])
    else 1) *
    (if i.succAbove (φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a) < i then
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a])
    else 1)

    φsΛ.signInsertNone φ φs i = ∏ (a : φsΛ.1), ∏ (x : a),
      (if i.succAbove x < i then 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[x.1]) else 1)

entries.name: WickContraction.signInsertSomeProd_eq_one_if
entries.snippet:
lemma signInsertSomeProd_eq_one_if (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (hφj : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j.1])) :
  φsΛ.signInsertSomeProd φ φs i j =
  ∏ (a : φsΛ.1),
    if (φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract a) < j
      ∧ (i.succAbove (φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract a) < i ∧ i < i.succAbove (φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a)
      ∨ j < (φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a) ∧ ¬ i.succAbove (φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract a) < i)
    then
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a])
    else
      1

entries.name: WickContraction.signInsertSomeProd_eq_prod_prod
entries.snippet:
lemma signInsertSomeProd_eq_prod_prod (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) (hφj : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j.1]))
    (hg : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ) :
  φsΛ.signInsertSomeProd φ φs i j =
  ∏ (a : φsΛ.1), ∏ (x : a.1), if x.1 < j
      ∧ (i.succAbove x.1 < i ∧
      i < i.succAbove ((φsΛ.getDual? x.1).get (getDual?_isSome_of_mem φsΛ a x))
      ∨ j < ((φsΛ.getDual? x.1).get (getDual?_isSome_of_mem φsΛ a x)) ∧ ¬ i.succAbove x < i)
    then
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[x.1])
    else
      1

entries.name: WickContraction.signInsertSomeProd_eq_prod_fin
entries.snippet:
lemma signInsertSomeProd_eq_prod_fin (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) (hφj : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j.1]))
    (hg : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ) :
  φsΛ.signInsertSomeProd φ φs i j =
    ∏ (x : Fin φs.length),
      if h : (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome then
          if x < j ∧ (i.succAbove x < i ∧ i < i.succAbove ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h)
            ∨ j < ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h) ∧ ¬ i.succAbove x < i)
          then 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[x.1])
          else 1
      else 1

    φsΛ.signInsertSomeProd φ φs i j =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ (List.filter (fun x => (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome ∧
      ∀ (h : (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome), x < j ∧ (i.succAbove x < i ∧
      i < i.succAbove ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h)
      ∨ j < ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h) ∧ ¬ i.succAbove x < i))
    (List.finRange φs.length)).map φs.get)

lemma signInsertSomeProd_eq_finset (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) (hφj : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j.1]))

      ∀ (h : (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome),
      x < j ∧ (i.succAbove x < i ∧ i < i.succAbove ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h)
      ∨ j < ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h) ∧ ¬ i.succAbove x < i)))⟩)

entries.name: WickContraction.signInsertSomeCoef_if
entries.snippet:
lemma signInsertSomeCoef_if (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) (hφj : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j.1])) :
    φsΛ.signInsertSomeCoef φ φs i j =
    if i < i.succAbove j then
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨(φs.insertIdx i φ).get,
      (signFinset (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)) (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)
      (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j)))⟩)
    else
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨(φs.insertIdx i φ).get,
      signFinset (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j))
      (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j))
      (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)⟩)

entries.name: WickContraction.signInsertSome_mul_filter_contracted_of_lt
entries.snippet:
lemma signInsertSome_mul_filter_contracted_of_lt (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted)

entries.name: WickContraction.staticContract
entries.docstring:
Given a Wick contraction `φsΛ` associated with a list `φs`, the
  product of all time-contractions of pairs of contracted elements in `φs`,
  as a member of the center of `𝓞.A`.

entries.name: WickContraction.staticContract_insertAndContract_none
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma staticContract_insertAndContract_none (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).staticContract = φsΛ.staticContract

entries.name: WickContraction.staticContract_insertAndContract_some
entries.docstring:
For `φsΛ` a Wick contraction for `φs = φ₀…φₙ`, the time contraction
  `(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).timeContract 𝓞` is equal to the multiple of
- the time contraction of `φ` with `φⱼ` if `i < i.succAbove j` else
    `φⱼ` with `φ`.
- `φsΛ.timeContract 𝓞`.
This follows from the fact that `(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j))` has one more contracted pair than `φsΛ`,
corresponding to `φ` contracted with `φⱼ`. The order depends on whether we insert `φ` before
or after `φⱼ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma staticContract_insertAndContract_some
    (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).staticContract =
    (if i < i.succAbove j then
      ⟨[anPart φ, ofFieldOp φs[j.1]]ₛ, superCommute_anPart_ofFieldOp_mem_center _ _⟩
    else ⟨[anPart  φs[j.1], ofFieldOp φ]ₛ, superCommute_anPart_ofFieldOp_mem_center _ _⟩) *
    φsΛ.staticContract

lemma staticConract_insertAndContract_some_eq_mul_contractStateAtIndex_lt

    (hik : i < i.succAbove k) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).staticContract =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (φsΛ.uncontracted.filter (fun x => x < k))⟩)
    • (contractStateAtIndex φ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ ((uncontractedStatesEquiv φs φsΛ) (some k)) *
      φsΛ.staticContract)

entries.name: WickContraction.timeContract
entries.docstring:
Given a Wick contraction `φsΛ` associated with a list `φs`, the
  product of all time-contractions of pairs of contracted elements in `φs`,
  as a member of the center of `𝓞.A`.

entries.name: WickContraction.timeContract_insertAndContract_none
entries.docstring:
For `φsΛ` a Wick contraction for `φs`, the time contraction `(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).timeContract 𝓞`
  is equal to `φsΛ.timeContract 𝓞`.

This result follows from the fact that `timeContract` only depends on contracted pairs,
and `(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none)` has the 'same' contracted pairs as `φsΛ`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma timeContract_insertAndContract_none
    (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).timeContract = φsΛ.timeContract

entries.name: WickContraction.timeConract_insertAndContract_some
entries.docstring:
For `φsΛ` a Wick contraction for `φs = φ₀…φₙ`, the time contraction
  `(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).timeContract 𝓞` is equal to the multiple of
- the time contraction of `φ` with `φⱼ` if `i < i.succAbove j` else
    `φⱼ` with `φ`.
- `φsΛ.timeContract 𝓞`.
This follows from the fact that `(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j))` has one more contracted pair than `φsΛ`,
corresponding to `φ` contracted with `φⱼ`. The order depends on whether we insert `φ` before
or after `φⱼ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma timeConract_insertAndContract_some
    (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).timeContract =
    (if i < i.succAbove j then
      ⟨FieldOpAlgebra.timeContract φ φs[j.1], timeContract_mem_center _ _⟩
    else ⟨FieldOpAlgebra.timeContract φs[j.1] φ, timeContract_mem_center _ _⟩) *
    φsΛ.timeContract

entries.snippet:
lemma timeConract_insertAndContract_some_eq_mul_contractStateAtIndex_not_lt
    (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (ht : ¬ 𝓕.timeOrderRel φs[k.1] φ) (hik : ¬ i < i.succAbove k) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).timeContract =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (φsΛ.uncontracted.filter (fun x => x ≤ k))⟩)
    • (contractStateAtIndex φ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ
      ((uncontractedStatesEquiv φs φsΛ) (some k)) * φsΛ.timeContract)

entries.name: WickContraction.fin_list_sorted_split
entries.snippet:
lemma fin_list_sorted_split :
    (l : List (Fin n)) → (hl : l.Sorted (· ≤ ·)) → (i : ℕ) →
    l = l.filter (fun x => x.1 < i) ++ l.filter (fun x => i ≤ x.1)
  | [], _, _ => by simp
  | a :: l, hl, i => by
    simp only [List.sorted_cons] at hl
    by_cases ha : a < i
    · conv_lhs => rw [fin_list_sorted_split l hl.2 i]
      rw [← List.cons_append]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_pos, List.filter_cons_of_neg]
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, not_le, ha]
      simp [ha]
    · have hx : List.filter (fun x => decide (x.1 < i)) (a :: l) = []

entries.name: WickContraction.fin_list_sorted_indexOf_filter_le_mem
entries.snippet:
lemma fin_list_sorted_indexOf_filter_le_mem :
    (l : List (Fin n)) → (hl : l.Sorted (· ≤ ·)) → (i : Fin n) →
    (hl : i ∈ l) →
    List.indexOf i (List.filter (fun x => decide (↑i ≤ ↑x)) l) = 0
  | [], _, _, _ => by simp
  | a :: l, hl, i, hi => by
    simp only [List.sorted_cons] at hl
    by_cases ha : i ≤ a
    · simp only [ha, decide_true, List.filter_cons_of_pos]
      have ha : a = i

entries.name: WickContraction.fin_list_sorted_indexOf_mem
entries.snippet:
lemma fin_list_sorted_indexOf_mem :
    (l : List (Fin n)) → (hl : l.Sorted (· ≤ ·)) → (i : Fin n) →
    (hi : i ∈ l) →
    l.indexOf i = (l.filter (fun x => x.1 < i.1)).length

entries.name: WickContraction.orderedInsert_of_fin_list_sorted
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsert_of_fin_list_sorted :
    (l : List (Fin n)) → (hl : l.Sorted (· ≤ ·)) → (i : Fin n) →
    List.orderedInsert (· ≤ ·) i l = l.filter (fun x => x.1 < i.1) ++
    i :: l.filter (fun x => i.1 ≤ x.1)
  | [], _, _ => by simp
  | a :: l, hl, i => by
    simp only [List.sorted_cons] at hl
    by_cases ha : i ≤ a
    · simp only [List.orderedInsert, ha, ↓reduceIte, Fin.val_fin_lt, decide_eq_true_eq, not_lt,
      List.filter_cons_of_neg, Fin.val_fin_le, decide_true, List.filter_cons_of_pos]
      have h1 : List.filter (fun x => decide (↑x < ↑i)) l = []

entries.name: WickContraction.orderedInsert_eq_insertIdx_of_fin_list_sorted

    List.orderedInsert (· ≤ ·) i l = l.insertIdx (l.filter (fun x => x.1 < i.1)).length i

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrder_uncontracted_none
entries.docstring:
Let `c` be a Wick Contraction for `φs := φ₀φ₁…φₙ`.
We have (roughly) `𝓝ᶠ([φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none]ᵘᶜ) = s • 𝓝ᶠ(φ :: [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)`
Where `s` is the exchange sign for `φ` and the uncontracted fields in `φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁`.
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrder_uncontracted_none (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none]ᵘᶜ)
    = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, φsΛ.uncontracted.filter (fun x => i.succAbove x < i)⟩) •
    𝓝(ofFieldOpList (φ :: [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.normalOrder_uncontracted_some
entries.docstring:
Let `c` be a Wick Contraction for `φ₀φ₁…φₙ`.
We have (roughly) `N(c ↩Λ φ i k).uncontractedList`
is equal to `N((c.uncontractedList).eraseIdx k')`
where `k'` is the position in `c.uncontractedList` corresponding to `k`.
entries.snippet:
lemma normalOrder_uncontracted_some (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)]ᵘᶜ)
    = 𝓝(ofFieldOpList (optionEraseZ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ φ ((uncontractedStatesEquiv φs φsΛ) k)))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.wick_term_none_eq_wick_term_cons
entries.docstring:
Let `φsΛ` be a Wick Contraction for `φs = φ₀φ₁…φₙ`. Then the wick-term of ` (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none)`

```(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).sign • (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).timeContract 𝓞 * 𝓞.crAnF 𝓝ᶠ([φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none]ᵘᶜ)```

is equal to

`s • (φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract 𝓞 * 𝓞.crAnF 𝓝ᶠ(φ :: [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ))`

where `s` is the exchange sign of `φ` and the uncontracted fields in `φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁`.

The proof of this result relies primarily on:
- `normalOrderF_uncontracted_none` which replaces `𝓝ᶠ([φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none]ᵘᶜ)` with
  `𝓝ᶠ(φ :: [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)` up to a sign.
- `timeContract_insertAndContract_none` which replaces `(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).timeContract 𝓞` with
  `φsΛ.timeContract 𝓞`.
- `sign_insert_none` and `signInsertNone_eq_filterset` which are used to take account of
  signs.
entries.snippet:
lemma wick_term_none_eq_wick_term_cons (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).sign • (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).timeContract
    * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none]ᵘᶜ) =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => i.succAbove k < i))⟩)
    • (φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList (φ :: [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.wick_term_some_eq_wick_term_optionEraseZ
entries.docstring:
Let `c` be a Wick Contraction for `φ₀φ₁…φₙ`.
This lemma states that
`(c.sign • c.timeContract 𝓞) * N(c.uncontracted)`
for `c` equal to `c ↩Λ φ i (some k)` is equal to that for just `c`
mulitiplied by the exchange sign of `φ` and `φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁`.
entries.snippet:
lemma wick_term_some_eq_wick_term_optionEraseZ (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (hlt : ∀ (k : Fin φs.length), timeOrderRel φ φs[k])
    (hn : ∀ (k : Fin φs.length), i.succAbove k < i → ¬ timeOrderRel φs[k] φ) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).sign • (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).timeContract
      * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)]ᵘᶜ) =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => i.succAbove x < i))⟩)
    • (φsΛ.sign • (contractStateAtIndex φ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ
      ((uncontractedStatesEquiv φs φsΛ) (some k)) * φsΛ.timeContract)
    * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList (optionEraseZ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ φ (uncontractedStatesEquiv φs φsΛ k))))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.wick_term_cons_eq_sum_wick_term
entries.docstring:
Given a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs = φ₀φ₁…φₙ` and an `i`, we have that
`(φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract 𝓞) * 𝓞.crAnF (φ * 𝓝ᶠ([φsΛ]ᵘᶜ))`
is equal to the product of
- the exchange sign of `φ` and `φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁`,
- the sum of `((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i k).sign • (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i k).timeContract 𝓞) * 𝓞.crAnF 𝓝ᶠ([φsΛ ↩Λ φ i k]ᵘᶜ)`
  over all `k` in `Option φsΛ.uncontracted`.

The proof of this result primarily depends on
- `crAnF_ofState_mul_normalOrderF_ofStatesList_eq_sum` to rewrite `𝓞.crAnF (φ * 𝓝ᶠ([φsΛ]ᵘᶜ))`
- `wick_term_none_eq_wick_term_cons`
- `wick_term_some_eq_wick_term_optionEraseZ`
entries.snippet:
lemma wick_term_cons_eq_sum_wick_term (φ : 𝓕.States) (φs : List 𝓕.States) (i : Fin φs.length.succ)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (hlt : ∀ (k : Fin φs.length), timeOrderRel φ φs[k])
    (hn : ∀ (k : Fin φs.length), i.succAbove k < i → ¬timeOrderRel φs[k] φ) :
    (φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract) * ((ofFieldOp φ) * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)) =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => i.succAbove x < i))⟩) •
    ∑ (k : Option φsΛ.uncontracted), ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i k).sign •
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i k).timeContract * (𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ ↩Λ φ i k]ᵘᶜ)))

entries.name: FieldSpecification.wicks_theorem_nil
entries.docstring: Wick's theorem for the empty list.
entries.snippet:
lemma wicks_theorem_nil :
    𝓣(ofFieldOpList (𝓕 := 𝓕) []) = ∑ (nilΛ : WickContraction [].length),
    (nilΛ.sign (𝓕 := 𝓕) • nilΛ.timeContract) * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList [nilΛ]ᵘᶜ)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.wicks_theorem_congr
entries.snippet:
lemma wicks_theorem_congr {φs φs' : List 𝓕.States} (h : φs = φs') :
    ∑ (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length), (φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract) * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)
    = ∑ (φs'Λ : WickContraction φs'.length), (φs'Λ.sign • φs'Λ.timeContract) *
      𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φs'Λ]ᵘᶜ)

entries.name: FieldSpecification.wicks_theorem
entries.docstring:
Wick's theorem for time-ordered products of bosonic and fermionic fields.
  The time ordered product `T(φ₀φ₁…φₙ)` is equal to the sum of terms,
  for all possible Wick contractions `c` of the list of fields `φs := φ₀φ₁…φₙ`, given by
  the multiple of:
- The sign corresponding to the number of fermionic-fermionic exchanges one must do
    to put elements in contracted pairs of `c` next to each other.
- The product of time-contractions of the contracted pairs of `c`.
- The normal-ordering of the uncontracted fields in `c`.
entries.snippet:
theorem wicks_theorem : (φs : List 𝓕.States) → 𝓣(ofFieldOpList φs) =
    ∑ (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length), (φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract) * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)
  | [] => wicks_theorem_nil
  | φ :: φs => by
    have ih

entries.name: listDif
entries.snippet:
def listDif : (a: List String) → (b : List String) → (List String × List String)
  | [], [] => ([], [])
  | a :: as, [] => (a :: as, [])
  | [], b :: bs => ([], b :: bs)
  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
    if a = b then listDif as bs
    else (a :: (listDif as bs).1, b :: (listDif as bs).2)
